items.title: Hussain kehte hue
items.body:
chala hun janibe kaaba Hussain kehte hue
khuda se aaj milon ga Hussain kehte huay
sipahi daudtay jatay hain janibe koofa
panah maang rahay thay ke kholo darwaaza
kiya hai ghazi ne hamla Hussain kehte hue
pul-e Siraat ka dar ho to ho bhala kaisay
zamana dekh le aashor karbalaa ja ke
guzarti jati hai duniya Hussain kehte hue
karenge khoon ka maatam baroze aashorah
khuda se hum ko isi wastay to manga gaya
hamein hai maaon ne paala Hussain kehte hue
adhoora chhod ke hajj karbalaa jo aaye thay
khaday hain gird woh bint-e Ali ke khaimay ke
tawaf karte hain poora Hussain kehte hue
kaha Hussain ne marna nahi habib abhi
ke karbalaa mein zaroorat padegi mujh ko teri
habib hogaya zindah Hussain kehte hue
agar ho ahle tawalla mitaao yeh tafriq
namaz ho ya Azaa mil ke honge saare shareek
uthao tum bhi qama ya Hussain kehte hue
yahi waseela hai saari duaon ka behtar
poukaro bhai ko bhai ka vaastaa day kar
Hasan se maang lo sadqa Hussain kehte hue
tamam ghar huwa khushiyon se aaj baagh o bahar
pidar ke samnay boli hai beti pehli baar
sakeena aayi hai baba Hussain kehte hue
hai mera sher wasiyat banam Ahle azaa
yeh iltija hai ke akbar ko aaye jab bhi qaza
uthana mera janaza Hussain kehte hue

items.title: Musibat uthayegi Fizza
items.body:
Nabi ke badh musibat uthayegi fizza
Rida luta ke magar deen bachayegi fizza
Giraya jayega jis waqt fathima pe wo darr
Nishan wafa ke dikhenge , jhulaste hathon par
Wo jalte darr ko joh tanha hatayegi fizza
Joh lout aayenge masjid se zaqmi sarr leke
Jigar ko tham ke aur kap kapate hathon se
Ali ke zaqm pe pe marham lagayegi fizza
Hasan ke lashe pe teeron ka sayebaañ hoga
Sharik e hazrath e Zainab ka karne farz ada
Badan se teer wo wo saare , chudayegi fizza
Hussain maare gaye gyarwin ki subha huwi
Tamam rath yehi soch soch kar royi
Kafan kahan se shah e deen ka layegi fizza
Sakina zainab o zehra ke zaqm per aksar
Ye apne ansu se marham laga tou degi magar
Kisi ko dard na apna dikhayegi fizza
Yazeed bolega jis waqt barsaare darbaar
Kamosh karke use jab karegi wo guftaar
Jalal apna wahan per dikhayegi fizza
Dayar e sham me ismat ki malika bankar
Baqaul zainab o kulsum apni maa bankar
Sitam se shimr ke unko bachayegi fizza
Palat ke aayi madine joh badh e karbobala
Ali ke ghar joh gayi tou rajjul kiya nouha
Hussain aao ke paani pilayegi fizza

items.title: Yateem Hogaye Abbas Haye Wawaila
items.body:
Ali Ke Sher Ke Sar Se Ali Ka Saya Utha
Yateem Hogay Abbas Haye Wawaila
1- Chala Di Sar Pe Jo Talwaar Ibne Muljim Ne
Khuda Ka Ghar Huwa Rangeen Khoone Haider Se
Bicha Ke Farshe Aza Keh Rahe Hain Ahle Aza
2- Shaheed Kar Diya Sajde Me Ik Namaazi Ko
Ye Kamsini Me Mila Kaisa Daag Gazi Ko
Pisar Ki Aankho Se Rukte Nahi Hain Ashqe Aza
3- Ali Ka Laal Ye Manzar Kabhi N Bhulega
Lahu Me Duba Huwa Sar Kabhi N Bhulega
Padar Ke Baad Gazanfar Ki Khaak Hai Duniya
4- Wo Jisne Loriya Dekar Sulaya Bete Ko
Wo Jisne Ungli Pakad Kar Chalaya Bete Ko
Janaza Uthta Hai Aise Kareem Baba Ka
5- Fir Ahlebait Pe Allah Kya Musibat Hai
Hasan Ke Kandho Pe Shere Khuda Ki Mayyat Hai
Uda Ke Khaak Ye Jibreel Padhte Hain Nouha
6- Zami Ko Chain Nahi Gam Se Aasma Nam Hai
Abu Turaab Ki Mazloomi Ka Ye Aalam Hai
Jaha Se Roze Ki Haalat Me Rozadaar Chala
7- Jo Bhar N Payega Wo Zakhm Dil Pe Khaya Hai
Ali Ke Laal Ne Ye Pehla Gam Uthaya Hai
Dilaasa Deti Hai Bhai Ko Saniye Zahra S.A
8- Ali Ko Asr Ka Manzar Lahu Rulata Hai
Wo Khooni Dasht Jo Moula Ko Yaad Aata Hai
Jari Ke Baazu Gala Choomte Hain Sarwar Ka
9- Libaase Sog Me Farhaan Sara Aalam Hai
Kahi Pe Nouha Hai Rizwa Kahi Pe Maatam Hai
Jari Ko Deta Hai Ye Keh Ke Har Koi Pursa

items.title: Ajeeb Qaidi Hain Saray Quran Parhday Hin
items.body:
عـــجیب قـــــیدی ہیں، ســـــارے قـــــرآن پڑھــتے ہیں
ہر کــــوئی پانی رُوتا ہے، وہ خون بیٹھے روتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
محــــسوس ایسے ہوتا ہے ، یہ پردہ دار گھــــــر کے
کچھ بھی نہیں وہ مانگیں ، چند برقــعے صرف مانگتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
ہر گلے میں رســـــن ہے ، رَسیوں سے خون بہتا ہے
سچ پوچھے تُو جو ھندہ ، بے جرم سـارے لَگتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
ایک ھے صـغـــــیر قـــــیدن ، ناپ جس کا ہے سکــــــــینہؑ
دُر دیکھ دیکھ کہتی ، دُر میرے رَمـــــلہ لگـتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
تُوں کہتی ہے کہ میرا ، مُرشــــد حســــــــین سُوھنا
ناراض جے نہ تُو ہو ، اے سب حســــین کگتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
کئی گھنٹے تھی گئے ھــــــــــن، کوئی نئیں گلینــــدا
کَھل کَھل کے قـــــیدیاں دے، لگـــدا اے پیر دُکھدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
رَمـــــــــــــــلہ کے بین سُـن کے ، دربار آئی ھندہ
سر پیٹ کے وہ بولی ، ســــــردار یوں نہ لُٹتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
نوشــــاد بنتِ زھـــــرہؑ ، ھنــــدہ کــــو دیکــــھ رو دی
پہـــــچان میں ہوں زیینبؑ ، نہ میرے بال چُھپتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
عـــجیب قـــــیدی ہن، ســـــارے قـــــرآن پڑھــدے ھن
ہر کــــوئی پانی رُوندا، اَو خــــــــــون بیٹھے روندے ھن

محــــسوس ایویں تھیندائے، اِیناں پردہ دار گھــــــر دے
بیا کُج نئیں اُو منگدے، چند برقــعے بیٹھے منگدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
ہر گل دے وچ رَســـــن اے، رَسیاں چُوں خُـــون وہندائے
سچ پُچھدی ایں جے ہنداں، بے جرم سـارے لَگدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
اِک ھے صـغـــــیر قـــــیدن، جیندا اے ناں سکــــــــینہؑ
دُر مینڈے ویکھ آہندی، دُر مینڈے رَمـــــلہ لگــــدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
تُوں آہندی ایں جے میرا، مُرشــــد حســــــــین سُوھنا
ناراض جے نہ تھیویں، اے قـُــــل حســــین ڈِسدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
کئی گھنٹے تھی گئے ھــــــــــن، کوئی نئیں گلینــــدا
کَھل کَھل کے قـــــیدیاں دے، لگـــدا اے پیر دُکھدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
رَمـــــــــــــــلہ دے وَین سُـــــــــن کے، دربار آئی ہنداں
چـــــــــادر لہا کے رو پئی، ســــــردار اینج نہ لُٹدے ھن
<<DIVIDER>>
نوشــــاد بنتِ زھـــــرہ، ہنــــداں کُــــوں ویکــــھ رَو پئی
پہـــــچان میں ہاں زیینب، نہ مینــــڈے وال لُکـــدے ھن

items.title: Yasrab ke musafir
items.body:
یثرب کے مسافر سے قریب موت کا بن ہے
ہمراہ قضا سید آوارہ وطن ہے
<<DIVIDER>>
منزل سے ہے نزدیک محمد کا نواسہ
اب ختم سفر ہو چکا شاہ شہداء کا
رہ رہ کے دہل جاتا ہے زینب کا کلیجہ
منہ دیکھ کے بھائی کا پریشان بہن ہے
یثرب کے مسافر سے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
کرتا ہے کوئی راتوں کو جنگل میں یہ نالے
قربان ہو ماں تجھ پہ میرے نازوں کے پالے
بچے تجھے کرتی ہوں میں خالق کے حوالے
ڈر تھا مجھے لٹنے کا جہاں یہ وہی بن ہے
یثرب کے مسافر سے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
اس دشت میں پاے گا تو ہر طرح کی ایذا
اس دشت میں دشمن تیری ہو جاے گی دنیا
لای ہے تجھے موت یہاں کھینچ کے بیٹا
شبیر یہ تیرا ہی بس اب تیرا وطن ہے
یثرب کے مسافر سے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
پیاسا تجھے جب ذبح کرے یہ ستم آرا
لاشے کا بھی ہوگا نہ کوئی گاڑنے والا
بیٹا تیری مظلومی کے قربان یہ دکھیا
نے غسل قسمت میں تیری اور نہ کفن ہے
یثرب کے مسافر سے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
لٹ جاے گا پیاسا تیرا یہ چھوٹا سا لشکر
اک بوندھ بھی پانی کی نہ دیگا کوئی خود سر
چلاے گا بے شیر کو تو ہاتھوں پہ لے کر
لوگوں میرا معصوم بہت تشنہ دہن ہے
یثرب کے مسافر سے۔۔۔

items.title: Zainab hoo mai
items.body:
زینب نے خطبہ دیا دربار ہلنے لگا
خطبات کی تیغ سے یہ کہکے حملہ کیا
زینب ہوں میں میرا بابا علی میری ماں سیدہ
<<DIVIDER>>
اے شامیوں گوہر سے تم سنو آج خطبہ میرا
زینب ہوں میں میرا بابا علی میری ماں سیدہ
<<DIVIDER>>
یہ نہ سمجھو کہ مجبور و لاچار ہوں
عظم شبیر حیدر کی تلوار ہوں
مرضیء رب سے غم میں گرفتار ہوں
بعد عباس میں ہی علمدار ہوں
پہچان لو سن کے لہجہ میرا کون ہوں با خدا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
جان جاؤ گے تم میرا نام و نصب
جس نے پایا ہے شیر خدا کا لقب
اس کی بیٹی ہوں میں جانتے ہیں یہ سب
آج دیکھو گے تم میرا غیض و غضب
میں شام کو جیت کر جاؤنگی عظم ہے یہ میرا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
میری رگ رگ میں ہے خون خیبر شکن
کیا مجھے قید کر پاے گی یہ رسن
شیر جیسے برادر کی ہوں میں بہن
کانپ جاے نگے لہجے سے کیوں ہو دمن
وعدہ وفا میں کرونگی یہاں بھائی شبیر کا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
ابن مرجان جیسا نجس آدمی
یہ سمجھتا ہے فتح اسے مل گئی
قتل ہوکر بھی زندہ ہے میرا اخی
ہے دلوں پر حکومت میرے بھائی کی
بعد از حسین بن گیء میں حسین یہ رجز ہے میرا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
دیکھنا کام ایسا میں کر جاؤنگی
ہوگی اس شہر پر بھی حکومت میری
ہوگی مجلس یہاں پر میرے بھائی کی
میں مٹا دونگی زہنوں سے یوں تیرگی
ہوگا وہی میں نے جو کہہ دیا یہ ہے دعویٰ میرا
<<DIVIDER>>
میرے خطبوں سے گونجے گی یہ وادیاں
لہجہء حیدری ہوگا سب پہ عیاں
یوں گرا دوں گی خطبات کی بجلیاں
اب یہ ایوان ظلمت رہیں گے کہاں
رہ جاے نگے اس فضا میں اثر میری آواز کا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
شام والوں سنو بات میری مزید
جتنا چاہو کرو ظلم ہم پر شہید
مجھکو خود پر بھروسہ ہے رب پر امید
بھول جائے گا بیعت کی باتیں یزید
یہ عزم ہے اور علان ہے کرکے دیکھو وغا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
تم کہاں اور زہرا کی بیٹی کہاں
روک پائیں گے کیا مجھکو یہ سختیاں
توڑ ڈالونگی میں پہنادو تم بیڑیاں
جتنی چاہے بھی پہنادو تم بیڑیاں
جانا نہیں تم نے شاید مجھے سن‌لو اہل جفا
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
بنت حیدر کا صفدر یہ علان تھا
اپنے بھائی سے میں نے جو وعدہ کیا
سن لو اہل جفا سن لو اہل جفا
جان دیکر کرونگی وہ وعدہ وفا
مضطر ہوں میں اور قیدی بھی ہوں پھر بھی ہے حوصلہ
زینب ہوں میں۔۔۔

items.title: Zikre sheh karke
items.body:
ذکرِ شہ کرکے محبوں کو رلایا میں نے
اپنا گھر مجرای جنت میں بنایا میں نے
<<DIVIDER>>
شہ نے فرمایا کرونگا نہ گلہ امت کا
پانی دو روز نہ پایا تو نہ پایا میں نے
ذکرِ شہ کرکے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
شہ نے فرمایا میرے بھائی کے بازو کاٹے
اس پہ بھی ہاتھ نہ امت پہ اٹھایا میں نے
ذکرِ شہ کرکے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
مارا اکبر کو تو کہتا تھا یہی ابنِ نمیر
آج تصویر محمد کو مٹایا میں نے
ذکرِ شہ کرکے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
شہ نے قاصد سے کہا بیٹی کو کیا خط لکھا
آکے یاں ایک گھڑی چین نہ پایا میں نے
ذکرِ شہ کرکے۔۔۔
<<DIVIDER>>
کہیو صغرا سے کہ مشکل ہے وطن میں آنا
اب تو بی بی اس جنگل کو بسایا میں نے
ذکرِ شہ کرکے۔۔۔

items.title: Hayya ala khayril amal
items.body:
Hayya ala khair al amal, Hayya ala khair al amal,
Ye sada Mehdi ki hai, Hayya ala khair al amal,
Aa bicha farsh e aza, ae kehney walay Al Ajal
Al ajal kehna hai to, phir de sadaa tu Ya Hussain,
Girya o matam hi bas, ghaibat mein hai mera amal,
Jo sada hal min ki hai, wo mere jadd ki hai sada,
Karbala hai qafla, aa qafilay ke saath chal,
Kullo yaumi’n ashura, kullo arrz’n karbala,
Ajj hai ye karbala, aur shaam ka bazaar kal,
Pyaasey pe yalgaar hai, aur teeron ki bochaar hai,
Khaimay ke dar pe behen, aae mangti hai ajal
Us ka laasha hogaya, ghordo’n se haye paaimal,
Asar tak jis ne kiya, laashey uthaaney ka amal,
Kis tarhan poncha hai wo, haye naujawan ki laash par,
Is ke seeney se juda, kaisey kiya naizey ka phal,
Yaad rakheygi, Ali Asghar tujhe ye kainaat,
Teer tha jis haath mein, haan kardiya tu ne wo shal,
Le Navaid is sar pe le, in matami qadmo’n ki khaak,
Tu bhi paayega shifa, Iss khaak ko chehre pe mal,
Hayya ala khair al amal, Hayya ala khair al amal,
Ye sada Mehdi ki hai, Hayya ala khair al amal,
Aa bicha farsh e aza, ae kehney walay Al Ajal

items.title: Kehti thi madar aye ali akbar
items.body:

Kehti thi madaar ay Ali Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do(x2),
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Janti hu mein mujko khabar hai
tere labho par meri nazar hay
kuch hi palon ka aur safar hay
maa bhi teri majboor magar hay
laal mere humshakal-e-payambar
hoti hay subha azaan do,
Kehti thi maadar ay Ali Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do(x2)
<<DIVIDER>>

baba khare hay aap ke akber
aur udhar khaime ke andar bethi hay ghamghi zainab-e-muztar
karlo tayamum ay mere dilbar
hoti hay subha azaan do,
Kehti thi maadar ay mere Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do (x2)

karte hay saikal tegh ke upar
ghash me pare hay abide muztar
jhoole mein choop hay nanha sa asghar
toot na jaye zapt ka saagar
hoti hay subha azaan do
Kehti thi maadar ay mere Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>

aankh mein aansoon, haath mein kuzaa
iske labhon par pyaas ka dariya
aayi hay kehne tumse yeh beta
jaane tammanaa jaane khaahar
hoti hay subha azaan do,

<<DIVIDER>>

phirbhi hasi hay labh pe tumhare
Aajare aaja raj dulaare
budhi maa ki ankh ketaare
waqt bohot hay kam mere Akber
hoti hay subha azaan do,
Kehti thi maadar ay mere Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shaam se pehle khushk gale par
teghe chalega shimr ka khanjar
aur tumhari dukhiya maadar
bayn kareghi laash ke upar
phir na kahoonghi mein tumhe akber
hoti hay subha azaan do,
Kehti thi maadar ay mere Akber, hoti hay subha azaan do (x2)

7. Kaise likhe Gulshan woh manzar
murtaza aaya azaan jo dene
niklazabaan se allah ho akber
kholdiye saidaniyo ne sar
farsh pe kehkar girgayi maadar
hoti hay subha azaan do,

items.title: Lehed choti banayi kyun gayi hai
items.body:
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi
Reha hokar haram jab ran me pohche
kaha zainab ne abid se tadapke
shaheedo'n ki kaha'n qabrein bani hai
fugha'n karti ye aale nabi hai
kaha sajjad ne haaye phuphijaa'n
nahi tadfeen ka tha koi saamaa'n
wo dekho qabr hai baba ki mere
wo akbar ki ye qasim ki hamare
gaye sahil pe ek choti lehad par
tadap utthi ye keh kar binte haider
ye kiski qabr hai sajjad beta
hai isme dafn kis be ghar ka laasha
kiya phir aabid e muztar ne nauha
ke is me dafn hai laasha chacha ka
kaha zainab ne ay sajjad beta
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
Mera abbas to chota nahi tha
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Pukari SANIYE ZEHRA ay dilbar
Mere ABBAS ka aisa muqaddar
Lehad choti si aur GHAZI ka laasha
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
1) mere AABID phuphi jaa'n ko bata de
Chacha ki lash dafnayi hai kaise
Mera bhaiya jawano me siwa tha
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
2) Kisi choti si turbat me ay dilbar
Mera ABBAS soya hai to kyun kar
Badi mushkil me hoga mera bhaiya
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
3) mujhe lagta hai ay beemar mere
tha laasha ba wafa ka tukde tukde
zara apni phuphi amma ko batla
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
4) phuphi amma btaun mai ye kaise
Chacha KI lash k tukde the bikhre
Kia chun-chun ke jinko maine yak jaa'n
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
5) Tarai me chacha ki laash rakhi
bhatije ne banakar qabr chhoti
lehed me phir rakha unka janaza
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
6) Yehi kehti thi dadi mujhse rokar
ke ek tukda yaha par ek waha par
mera ghazi hai haaye paara paara
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2
7) 'Mubarak' jab kaha zehra ne rokar
nazar aata hai tukdo me dilawar
qayamat tak na ab aansu rukege
Lehad choti banayi kyun gayi hai-2

items.title: Sar Barehna Bhare Darbaar
items.body:
Sar barehna bharre darbaar kadi thi amma
Mujhpe woh kaisi qayamat ki gadi thi amma
Cheenli sar se rida meri sittamgaron ne
Teri Zainab pe musibat yeh badi thi amma
Mere baazu pe layino ne rasan baanda tha
Main woh har ek musibat se laddi thi amma
Maine dekha hai badan bhai ka tukhde tukdhe
Bhai katta raha main darr pe kaddi thi amma
Saari saydaaniya bas ek rasan mein thay bandhe
Aisi Ufkaari yeh kunbe pe paddi thi amma
Tasht mein sar mere maajaye ka mene dekha
Hont par bhai ke zaalim ki chaddi thi amma
Kabar Zehra pe Taqi thi yeh sada zainab ki
Kar rahe hai yeh bayan mirza sada zainab ki
Halq par bhai ke ek kund chori thi amma
Sar barehna bhare darbaar kadi thi amma
Mujhpe woh kaisi qayamat ki gadi thi amma

items.title: Yateem Karbobala Ka Rolay Jatay ha
items.body:
یتیم کرب و بلا کے رلائے جاتے ہیں
وہ سنگ ماؤوں کے قیدی بنائے جاتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
1)یوں ننھے ہاتھوں سے چھوٹا ہے ہاتھ ماؤوں کا
ہائے ننھے ہاتھوں پہ کوڑے لگائے جاتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
2)گلے میں رسی ہے اور اونٹ پر سوار بھی ہے
گلے سے کھینچ کے رسی گرائے جاتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
3)یہ مرگئے ہیں یا بےہوش پوچھتا نہ کوئی
نہ اِن کے کاندھے پکڑ کر ہِلائے جاتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
4)بندھے ہیں ہاتھ تو چہرہ چھپائیں گے کیسے
تبھی طماچے مسلسل لگائے جاتے ہیں
<<DIVIDER>>
ہائے سیدہ کے جو قاتل چھپائے جاتے ہیں

items.title: Ly Gayi Aye Rida Zainab
items.body:
Ly Gayi Aye Rida Zainab Di Ghazi Vi Leh Gaya
Haye Shaam De Safaran Layi Dukhiyaari Bibi Da Aik Abid Baaqi Reh Gayi
Noor De Waire Ch Jairi Noori Burqa Paa Ke
Kadhi Turdi Naye Si
Haaye Baaj Bhirawan De Pathran De Khaaran Te
Onu Pehdal Turhna Paye Gaya
Jinnu Akbar Ton Vi Pehle Ali Akbar Di Tarha
Paal Di Rayi Zainab
Oh Veer Juda Hoya Fir Jundiyan Zainab Layi
Aik Hasrat Ban Ke Reh Gaya
Apni Qaid Laye Zainab Aik Waari Jeena
Ro Saki Qaidaan Wich
Har Waari Rondi Rayi Ona Teeran Nu Jhere
Akhiyan Wich Ghazi Seh Gaya

items.body:

items.title: Hayya Alal Aza
items.body:
Hayya alal azaa, Ya hussain..
Hayya alal buqaa, Ya hussain..
Farshe azaa e karbo, bala ki hai ye sadaa..
Hayya alal azaa, Hayya alal buqaa..
1) Humko mila naseeb, se ye maatame hussain,
Rag rag me haiñ hamari, basa maatame hussain,
Rasme aza ki zainabe, muztar se haiñ baqaa..
2) Wo marsiya ho soz ho, ya girya o buka,
Kaala libas farshe, aza par hai ayeena,
Zanjeer qamma bediyañ, haiñ zeware aza..
3) Sarwar ka sogwar, lahed me jo jayega,
Zaade safar wo khake, shifa ko banayega,
Hogi nishaane maatame, shabbir se ziya..
4) Maahe aza ka chand, ufaq par jo ayega,
Har sogwar farshe, ghame shah bichayega,
sughra ko denge pursa, wo akbar jawaan ka..
5) Har su sabeel hogi, jo pyaaso ke naam ki,
Gurbat bayaañ karegi, wo pyaase imaam ki,
Haañ sogwaar hoga, har ek qatra aab ka..
6) Jab jab bhi farshe matame, sarwar pe aaiye,
Bachcho ko apne sath me, har aan laaiye,
Jaari rahe ye maataamo, majlis ka silsila..
7) Aayenge jab imam, banayenge wo baqeea,
Humraah leke ham ko bhi, jayenge wo baqeea,
Hoga ghame husain me, matam wahan bapa..
8) Ye matame husain, alaihissalam hai,
Ye karna ambiya o, malayek ka kaam hai,
Hum ko sharaf mila hai, ye mauqa shukr ka..
9) Aye waarise hussain ho, hum sab pa ye karam,
Nazro ke samne ho, jo abbas ka haram,
Zanjeer hath me ho, labo par ho ye sada..
Shukr e Maula as

items.title: Main Aapki Zehra Hun Baba
items.body:
Qabre Nabi Pa Fatema Zehra Ka Bain Tha

18 Baras Wali Dekho, Main Pehli Zaeefa Hoon Baba

Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehchaan Nahi Paoge Meri, Aankhon Mein Kaha Beenayi Hai
Hen Jhurriyaan Mere Chehre Par, Baalon Pe Safedi Chhaayi Hai
Main Lakht-e-Jigar To Aapki Thi, Ab Gham Ka Khazeena Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar Kar Bhi Nahi Qismat Mein Sukun, Roze Ko Bhi Mere Tod Diya
Din Mein Hai Musalsal Dhoop Yahan, Aur Shab Mein Bahut Hai Sannata
Ummat Ne Sitam Kab Roke Hain, Main Aaj Bhi Nishana Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Firdous Ki Shehzadi Bhi Khaali, Ye Ujdi Lehad Mein Rehti Hai
Baba Hai Payambar Aur Uski Beti Ye Museebat Sehti Hai
Ye Saare Musalmaan Bhool Gaye, Main Aapka Tukda Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

Har Ghar Se Sadaayein Aati Rahein, Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba
Main Aapki Zehra Hoon Baba

items.title: Muslim ka matam hota hai
items.body:

MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI

MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>

MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI
205
<<DIVIDER>>

GALIYON MEIN PHIRAYA LASHAY KO,
LATKAYA GAYA MEHMAAN KA SAR.
MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>

YASRAB KA MUSAFIR QATL HUA,

MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI

HAR SIMTH HAI SHOREH AAHO BUKA,
MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
7. MAJLIS KI HAI GHAR GHAR TAIYYARI,
ROUNAKH HAI MUHARRAM SI SARI,
AATI HAI SADA E WAWAILA.
MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
8. KYA AAE QAYAMATH KI MANZIL,
MUSLIM KI SHAHADATH SE SAHIL,
AAGAZ HUE HAI KARBOBALA.
MUSLIM KA MATAM HOTA HAI

items.title: Sar Barehna hai dayare gair Me binte ali
items.body:
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali
Haye Zainab Haye Shaam (2)
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
Abid E Dilgeer Ro'e Aur Sar E Shabbeer Bhi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
1) Dekh Ye Kaesi Hui Hai Teri Zainab Par Jafa
Waaris E Tat'heer Ho Kar Bhi Bahen Hai Be Rida
Haye Maiñ Lekar Balayeiñ Teri Kyuñ Na Mar Gayi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
2) Koi Mehmil Hai Na Haudaj Aur Nahiñ Sar Par Rida
Sar Pa Od'he Gham Ki Chaadar Chal Raha Hai Qafela
Aayiye Baba Madad Ko Hum Pa Aafat Hai Badi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
3) Ghir Gayi Hai Dushmano Ke Darmiyaañ Aal E Nabi
Koi Sadqa Phaiñk Ta Hai Sar Pa Angaare Koi
Khooñ Rulaata Hai Sinaañ Par Bhaai Ko Manzar Yehi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
4) Baba Baba Keh Ke Har Dam Roti Hai Dukhtar Teri
Sakhtiyaañ Ahl E Sitam Ki Sehti Hai Dukhtar Teri
Kar Rahi Hai Teri Beti Par Fughaañ Khud Be Kasi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
5) Jab Jari Ko Saniye Zehra Ka Sar Aaya Nazar
Aañkh Se Tapka Lahu Teh'ra Nahiñ Naize Pa Sar
Gir Gaya Karte Huwe Woh Khaak Par Nauha Yehi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
Haye zainab sa-2
6) Qafela Jab Shaam Ke Baazaar Me Aakar Ruka
Shaam Waloñ Se Ye Us Dam Ro Ke Fizza Ne Kaha
Apni Nazroñ Ko Jhukaao Hum Haiñ Namuse Nabi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
7) Kya anoosh e Ghamzada thi wo Qayamat ki ghadi
Jab kanizi me Jari ki laadli mangi gayi.
Thi sada har su'n Muqarrib Al madad Maula Ali
Kya "Muqarrib" Aur "Anoosh" Thi Wo Qayamath Ki Ghadi.
Jab Kanizi Me Jari Ki Laadli Mangi Gayi.
Sab ke Lab Par Yeh Sada Thi Al Madad Maula Ali (a.s).

items.body:
روایت میں ہے جب بھی
قافلہ دوڑایا جاتا تھا
سر شبیر نیزے سے
صدا یہ دیتا جاتا تھا
سنبھالو تم اسے زینب
ابھی بازار جانا ہے
یتیمی ہے سکینہ ہے
بڑا ظالم زمانہ ہے

کبھی درے لگاتے ہیں
ستمگر تیز ناقوں سے
اسے نیچے گراتے ہیں
سکینہ جب بھی روتی ہے
طمانچے بھی لگاتے ہیں
میری بچی کو اے زینب

کہاں سہ روز کے فاقے

چچا اور بھائی کے لاشے
بڑے صدمے اٹھاے ہیں
کیء راتوں کی جاگی ہے
ہمارے بعد سینے پر
تمہیں اس کو سلانا ہے
یتیمی ہے سکینہ ہے۔۔۔

یہ منظر خوں رُلاتا ہے
میرا سجاد غیرت سے
نگاہوں کو جھکاتا ہے
کہ ظالم اب سکینہ کو
کنیزی میں بلاتا ہے
بہن نا پاک نظروں سے
سکینہ کو چھپانا ہے
یتیمی ہے سکینہ ہے۔۔۔

یزید نحس کہتا ہے
میری بالی سکینہ سے
اگر ہے پیار بابا کو
تو کہہ دو سر سے قد آے
ہے وقت امتحاں زینب
میری بچی نہ مر جائے
ہمارے سر کو قد اٹھ کر
اب اس کے پاس جانا ہے

جو دیکھا شام کا منظر
انہیں لوگوں کے نرغے میں
گھری ہے آج بھی مضطر
وہی تنہائی اب بھی ہے
اندھیرا قید خانہ ہے

تم ہو گےء بیجاں۔۔۔

items.title: Har zulm ka nisha banaya batool ko
items.body:
HAR ZULM KA NISHANA BANAYA BATOOL KO X2
BABA KI TAAZIYAT MEI HAEY BABA KI TAAZIYAT MEI SATAYA BATOOL KO
ISS ZULM SE HILAYA GAYA MARQAD E RASOOL
IZHAR E TAAZIYAT MEI JALAYA DARRE BATOOL
GHURBAT KA TAAZIYANA LAGAYA BATOOL KO
HAIDER PE ZULM DHAYA GAYA DEKH TI RAHI
BAANDA GAYA ALI KA GALA DEKH TI RAHI
JO HO SAKA WO ZULM DIKHAYA BATOOL KO
HAQ MAANG NE GAYI THI YE KYA LEKE AAYI HAI
HONTO PE APNE AAH O BUKKA LEKE AAYI HAI
APNEH HI HAQ SE GHER BATAYA BATOOL KO
DARBAAR SE PALAT KE JO GHAR AAYI FATIMA
ZAINAB YEH BOLI BIBI HEY KYA NAAM APKA
SOUN KAR SAWAAL GUM SE GHASH AAYA BATOOL KO
CHUP CHUP KE JAAYA KARTI THI QABAR E RASOOL PAR
LEKIN JAB ASHKIYA KI PARI AAP PAR NAZAR
QABR E RASOOL SE BHI HATAYA BATOOL KO
BABA TERI JUDAYI KA SADHMA BHI KAM NE THA
PHIR BHI HUWA NA MUJPE WO KOI SITAM NE THA
WAJIB AMAL SAMAJ KE RULAYA BATOOL KO
QABR E NABI PE JAA KE YE KEHTI THI FATIMA
BABA TUMHARE GUM MEI NA RONEY MUJE DIYA
KHAMOSH JHIRKIYO SE KARAYA BATOOL KO
ZAHRA NE GUM JO DEKHY RAKAM HO ASAD SE KIA
PARTHE JO DEEN PE SHAB MEI BADAL JAATA FATEMAH
GUM NE QAZA KI NEENDH SULAYA BATOOL KO

items.title: Aa Gaya Ahle Aza Mahe Mauharram
items.body:
Aagaya ahle aza mahe muharram chalo watan ko chalen
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(1) Hilalo shaam e muharram ye kya khabar laaye
Ke ranjo dard k badal har ek taraf chhaye
Sabhi ye kahte hain
Na jaane kyon aakhir
Ye chand dekh k aankhon me ashk bhar aaye
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(2)Na jaane mahe muharram ki kaesi h taseer
Watan se door jinhen le ke jati h taqdeer
Wo is mahine me
Tamanna karte hain
Watan me ja ke karen hm bhi matam e shabbir
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(3) Watan se door jo rahte hain is mahine me
Watan ki yaad machalti h unke sine me
Mere pisar k muhib
Watan pahunch jayen
Duaen karti h ek maa'n yahi madine me
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(4)watan me ja kr ghame be watan manayenge
Nabi k laal pe ashke aza bichhayenge
Ghareeb khano me
Bichha k farshe gham
Janabe fatima zahra ko ham bolayenge
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(5) isi mahine me ujda h khandane batool
Isi mahine me mara gaya h jaane rasool
Isi mahine me
Nabi k gulshan ka
Bala k dasht me bikhra hua h har ek phool
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan chalen
(6)ba yade tashnagiye ibne fatima zahra
Sada pilayenge pyason ko pani ahle aza
Zamane walon ko
Batate jayenge
Ke karbala me tha nahre furat pe pahra
Har azadar ka dil kahta h paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(7) alam bhi hazrat e abbas ka uthayenge
Or uspe phool aqidat k ham chadhayenge
Mareez duniya k
Alam ki chhaon me
Ali k laal se aakr shifayen payenge
Har azadar ka dil kahta hai paiham chalo watan ko chalen
(8)watan se door jo rahte hain aye shabih o raza
Ye unse kah do sakina ko yaad kar len zara
sada jo roti thi
Watan ki yaadon me
Magar watan usey jana naseeb ho na saka
Har azadar ka dil kahta hai paiham chalo watan ko chalen

items.title: Amma tere hussain ne sab kuch luta diya
items.body:
Amma tere hussain ne sab kuch luta diya
Nana se jo kiya ta wo, wada niba diya
Kitni uthayi mayate, tere hussain ne
Kitne sitam uthayi, tere hussain ne
Kitne diye jala diye, maqtal saja diya
Pyassa hun teen roz ka, gham se nidal hun
Zakmo se choor choor hun, ashur dahal hun
Lekin tumhare laal ne, jungle basa diya
Karyal jawan ki laash pe, roya tera hussain
Abbas ki juda ime, luta hai dil ka chain
Kud apne dil ko karbala, maine bana diya
Ujra hai gul sitan mere, murja gaye hai phool
Qurbanniya hussain ki, kar lijiye kubool
Kya tha ye dashte karabala, or kya bana diya
Maqtal dalo ek nazar, be sar sab badan
Pala tha jinko qod mein, ye wo hai pur mahan
Meine ajal ki god mein, sab ko sula diya
Har sakte imtehaan se, guzra tera hussain
Lekin na rahe sab se, uthra tera hussain
Bayat ke har sawaal ko, meine mita diya
Qwaabe khaleel ke liye, tabeer ban gaya
Amma mein ranjo gham ki wo, tashweer ban gaya
Umat ne nana jaan ko, ayse sila diya
Tum dekhna ke ek din, aysa bhi ayega
Hoga har ek zubaan par, noha hussain ka

Gash kayega jise bhi ye, noha suna diya

items.title: Dasht-e-Vigha Main Noor-e-ḳhuda Ka Zuhur Hai
items.body:
dasht-e-viġha meñ nūr-e-ḳhudā kā zuhūr hai
dasht-e-viġhā meñ nūr-e-ḳhudā kā zuhūr hai
zarroñ meñ raushnī-e-tajallī-e-tūr hai
ik āftāb-e-ruḳh kī ziyā duur duur hai
kosoñ zamīn aks se dariyā-e-nūr hai
allāh-re husn tabqa-e-ambar-sarisht kā
maidān-e-karbalā hai namūna bahisht kā
hairāñ zamīñ ke nuur se hai charḳh-e-lājvard
mānind-e-kahrubā hai ruḳh-e-āftāb-e-zard
hai rū-kash-e-fazā-e-iram vādi-e-nabard
uThtā hai ḳhaak se tataq-e-nūr jā-e-gard
hairat se hāmilān-e-falak un ko takte haiñ
zarre nahīñ zamīñ pe sitāre chamakte haiñ
hai āb-e-nahr sūrat-e-ā.īna jalva-gar
tābāñ hai misl-e-chashma-e-ḳhurshīd har bhañvar
lahreñ bisān-e-barq chamaktī haiñ sar-ba-sar
paanī pe machhliyoñ kī Thahartī nahīñ nazar
ye āb-o-tāb hai ki guhar aab aab haiñ
dariyā to āsmāñ haiñ sitāre hubāb haiñ
partav-fagan huā jo ruḳh-e-qibla-e-anām
mash.hūr ho ga.ī vo zamīñ arsh-ehtishām
aur sañg-reze durr-e-najaf ban ga.e tamām
sahrā ko mil gayā sharaf-e-vādī-assalām
kaabe se aur najaf se bhī izzat sivā huī
ḳhaak us zamīn-e-pāk kī ḳhāk-e-shifā huī
phailā jo nūr-e-mahr-e-imāmat dam-e-zavāl
zarroñ se vaañ ke aañkh milānā huā muhāl
saare nihāl faiz-e-qadam se hue nihāl
aḳhtar bane jo phuul to shāḳheñ banīñ hilāl
patte tamām ā.īna-e-nūr ho ga.e
sahrā ke naḳhl sab shajar-e-tūr ho ga.e
ġhul thā zahe husain kī shaukat zahe vaqār
goyā khaḌe haiñ jañg ko mahbūb-e-kirdgār
ruḳh se ayaañ hai dabdaba-e-shāh-e-zul-fiqār
hai nūr-e-haq jabīn-e-munavvar se āshkār
kyūñkar chhupe na māh-e-do-hafta hijāb se
chauda tabaq meñ nuur hai us āftāb se
ye rū-e-raushan aur ye gesu-e-mushk-e-fām
yaañ shaam meñ to sub.h hai aur sub.h meñ hai shaam
haale meñ yuuñ nazar nahīñ aatā hai mah tamām
qudarat ḳhudā kī nuur kā zulmat meñ hai maqām
zulfoñ meñ jalva-gar nahīñ chehra janāb kā
hai nisf shab meñ aaj zuhūr āftāb kā
qurbāñ kamān-e-abrū-e-maulā pe jaan o dil
gar māh-e-nau kaheñ to hai tashbīh mubtazil
chashm-e-ġhazāl-e-dasht-e-ḳhutan chashm se ḳhajil
dekhā jise karam se ḳhatā.eñ huiiñ bahil
putlī bisān-e-qibla-numā be-qarār hai
giryāñ haiñ vo ye gardish-e-lail o nahār hai
ruḳhsār haiñ ziyā meñ qamar se ziyāda-tar
jin par Thahar sakī na kabhī shams kī nazar
rīsh-e-moḳhazzab aur ye ruḳh-e-shāh-e-bahr o bar
paidā haiñ saaf ma.anī-e-val-lailo-o-val-qamar
qur.ān se ayaañ hai buzurgī imaam kī
khaa.ī qasam ḳhudā ne isī sub.h o shaam kī
kis muñh se kījiye lab-e-jān-baḳhsh kā bayāñ
chūsī jinhoñ ne ahmad muḳhtār kī zabāñ
kyā durr-e-āb-dār haiñ is durj meñ nihāñ
goyā ki motiyoñ kā ḳhazāna hai ye dahāñ
zarre zamīñ pe aks se saare chamak ga.e
jis vaqt ye khile to sitār chamak ga.e
sham-e-harīm-e-lam-yazalī thā gulū-e-shāh
tārīk shab meñ jaise huvaidā ho nūr-e-māh
ai charḳh-e-be-madār ye kaisā sitam hai aah
shamshīr-e-shimr aur mohammad kī bosa-gāh
jis par rasūl hoñToñ ko malte hoñ pyaar se
kaT jaa.e karbalā maiñ vo ḳhanjar kī dhaar se
manzūr yaañ thī mad.h-e-gulū-e-shah-e-umam
yaad aa ga.ī magar ye hadīs-e-ġham-o-alam
masjid meñ jalva-gar the rasūl-e-falak-hasham
malte the zikr-e-haq meñ lab-e-pāk dam-ba-dam
raushan the bām-o-dar ruḳh-e-raushan ke nuur se
ā.īna ban ga.ī thī zamīñ tan ke nuur se
thā jo sutūñ ki rukn-e-risālat kā takiya-gāh
kursī bhī us kī pusht kī thī DhūñDhtī panāh
thā jis hasīr par vo do aalam kā bādshāh
hasrat se arsh kartā thā us farsh par nigāh
auj-e-zamīñ bahisht-e-barīñ se do-chand thā
mimbar kā nuh falak se bhī paaya buland thā
as.hāb-e-ḳhās gird the anjum kī tarah sab
tābāñ thā biich meñ vo mah-e-hāshmī-laqab

ḳhādim bilāl-o-qumbar-e-gardūñ-asās thā
nālain is ke paas asā us ke paas thā
gesū the vo mufassir-e-vallail-izā-sajā
ruḳh se ayaañ the ma.anī-e-vashshams-o-va-zzuhā
vo rīsh-e-pāk aur ruḳh-e-sardār-e-ambiyā
goyā dharā thā rehl pe qur.āñ khulā huā
oḌhe siyah abā jo vo ālam-panāh thā
kaaba kā saaf hājiyoñ ko ishtibāh thā
pahlū meñ bādshāh ke thā jalva-gar vazīr
sardār-e-dīñ alī-e-valī ḳhalq kā amiir
donoñ jahāñ meñ koī na donoñ kā thā nazīr
ahmad the āftāb to haidar mah-e-munīr
zāhir meñ ek nuur kā do jā zuhūr thā
gar ġhaur kījiye to vahī ek nuur thā
masrūf-e-vāz-o-pand the sultān-e-mashriqain
jo ghar se nikle khelte zohrā ke nuur ain
naanā baġhair donoñ navāsoñ ko thā na chain
baḌh jaate the hasan kabhī aage kabhī husain
kahte the dekheñ kaun qadam jald uThātā hai
naanā ke paas kaun bhalā pahle jaatā hai
vo gore gore chehroñ pe zulfeñ idhar udhar
aḳhtar se vo chamakte hue kaan ke guhar
rashk-e-hilāl tauq gale ġhairat-e-qamar
haikal pe naqsh naam ḳhudā-e-jalīl ke
tāvīz gardanoñ pe par-e-jibrīl ke
masjid meñ aa.e hañste hue jab vo gul-badan
ḳhushbū se sehan-e-masjid-e-jāme banā chaman
taslīm ko husain se pahle jhuke hasan
ḳhush ho ke muskurāne lage sarvar-e-zaman
baḌh baḌh ke ḳham salām ko chhoTe baḌe hue
baiThe rahe rasūl malak uTh khaḌe hue
beToñ ko thā alī kā ishāra ki baiTh jaao
lāzim nahīñ ki vaaz meñ naanā ko tum satāo
phailā ke haath bole mohammad ki aao aao
shabbīr ne kahā hameñ pahle gale lagāo
bhaa.ī hasan jo aap kī godī meñ aa.eñ ge
ham tum se naanā jaan abhī ruuTh jaa.eñ ge
bole hasan ki vaah hameñ aur kareñ na pyaar
iqrār ke chuke haiñ shahanshāh-e-nām-dār
bole ba-chashm-e-nam ye husain-e-falak-vaqār
dekheñ to kaun kāñdhe pe hotā hai ab savār
sab se sivā jo haiñ so hamīñ un ke pyāre haiñ
aage na baḌhiye aap ki naanā hamāre haiñ
bhaa.ī se tab kahā ye hasan ne ba-iltifāt
be-vaj.h ham se rūThe ho tum ai niko-sifāt
naanā hamāre kyā nahīñ sultān-e-kā.enāt
hotī hai nāgavār tumheñ to zarā sī baat
ġhussa na itnā chāhiye ḳhush-ḳhū ke vāste
machle the yuuñ hī bachcha-e-āhū ke vāste
ye sun ke muñh alī kā lage dekhne rasūl
hañs kar kahā ye donoñ haiñ mere chaman ke phuul
maiñ chāhtā huuñ ek kī ḳhātir na ho malūl
ro.eñge ye to ghar se nikal aa.egī butūl
hove na rañj mere kisī nūr-e-ain ko
tum lo hasan ko god meñ maiñ luuñ husain ko
shabbar se phir ishāra kiyā ho ke be-qarār
ġhussa na khaao pahle tumhīñ ko kareñge pyaar
phir bole dekh kar sū-e-shabbīr-e-nām-dār
aa ai husain aa tirī bātoñ ke maiñ nisār
chhātī se ham lagā.eñge jaan apnī jaan kar
dekheñ to pahle kaun lipaTtā hai aan kar
dauḌe ye baat sun ke barābar vo ḳhush-sayar
paas aa.e āftāb-e-risālat ke do qamar
lipTe husain hañs ke idhar aur hasan udhar
the paañv zānūoñ pe to bālā-e-dosh sar
naanā ke saath pyaar meñ donoñ kā saath thā
gardan meñ ek un kā aur un kā haath thā
phir phir ke dekhte the shahanshāh-e-mashriqain
gah jānib-e-hasan to kabhī jānib-e-husain
baiThe jo zānūoñ pe vo zehrā ke nūr-e-ain
thā tan ko lutf qalb ko rāhat jigar ko chain
jhuk jhuk ke muñh rasūl-e-zaman chūmne lage
in kā galā to un kā dahan chūmne lage
shabbīr chāhte the ki chūmeñ mire bhī lab
par kuchh gale ke bosoñ kā khultā na thā sabab
naanā ke muñh ke paas ye laate the muñh ko jab
jhuk jhuk ke chūmte the galā sayyad-e-arab
bhaa.ī ko dekh kar jo hasan muskurāte the
ġhairat se un kī āñkhoñ meñ aañsū bhar aate the
uTThe husain zānū-e-ahmad se ḳhashm-gīñ
ġhusse se rañg zard aur āñkhoñ pe āstīñ
ruḳh par pasīna jism meñ ra.asha jabīñ pa chiiñ
pūchhā kidhar chale to ye bole kahīñ nahīñ
ghar meñ akele tevarī chaḌhā.e chale ga.e
dekhā na phir ke sar ko jhukā.e chale ga.e
baitushsharf meñ aa.e jo shabbīr-e-nām-dār
kurte ko muñh pe rakh ke lage rone zār-zār
dauḌīñ ye kah ke fāima-zehrā jigar-figār
hai hai husain kyā huā tū kyuuñ hai ashk-bār
tujh ko rulā ke ġham meñ mujhe mubtalā kiyā
qurbān ho ga.ī tujhe kis ne ḳhafā kiyā
merā kaleja phahTtā hai ai dilrubā na ro
zehrā hazār jaan se tujh pe fidā na ro
sar meñ na dard ho kahīñ ai mah-laqā na ro
bas bas na ro husain barā-e-ḳhudā na ro
merī taraf to dekho ki betāb hotī huuñ
chādar se muñh ko Dhāñp ke lo maiñ bhī rotī huuñ
tū muñh to khol ai mire shabbīr-e-ḳhush-ḳhisāl
tar ho ga.e haiñ āñsuoñ se gore gore gaal
mal mal ke pusht-e-dast se aañkh karo na laal
suljhā.ūñ aao uljhe hue gesuoñ ke baal
ghar se ga.e the saath judā ho ke aa.e ho
samjhī maiñ kuchh hasan se ḳhafā ho ke aa.e ho
tum chup raho vo ghar meñ to masjid se phir ke aa.eñ
guzrī maiñ khel se mire bachche ko kyuuñ rulā.eñ
un se na boliyo vo tumheñ laakh gar manā.eñ
lo aao jaane do tumheñ chhātī se ham lagā.eñ
vaarī agar hasan ne rulāyā burā kiyā
pūchhūñgī kyā na maiñ mire pyāre ne kyā kiyā
bole husain ham to haiñ is baat par ḳhafā
naanā ne chūme bhaa.ī ke hoñT aur mirā galā
tum ammāñ-jān muñh ko to sūñgho mire zarā
kuchh bū-e-nāgavār hai mere dahan meñ kyā
bhaa.ī ke lab se apne laboñ ko milāte haiñ
ab ham na jaa.eñ ge hameñ naanā rulāte haiñ
muñh rakh ke muñh pe bolī ye zehrā jigar-figār
bū-e-gulāb aatī hai ai mere gul-azār
chūmā agar galā to ḳhafā ho na maiñ nisār
tum ko zabāñ chūsāte the mahbūb-e-kirdgār
ye mushk meñ mahak na gul-e-yāsman meñ hai
ḳhush-bū usī dahan kī tumhāre dahan meñ hai
kahne lage husain ye maañ se ba-chashm-e-nam
kyā jaano tum hasan se hameñ chāhte haiñ kam
ye kyā unhīñ pe lutf-o-ināyat hai dam-ba-dam
mālūm ho gayā unheñ pyāre nahīñ haiñ ham
ro ro ke aaj jaan ham apnī gañvā.eñge
paanī na ab piyeñge na khāne ko khā.eñge
ye baat sun ke ho gayā zehrā kā rañg faq

sadqe ga.ī karo na kaleje ko mere shaq
hai hai ye kyā kahā mujhe hotā hai ab qalaq

kaahe ko maañ jiyegī jo khānā na khāoge
ye kah ke oḌh lī sar-e-pur-nūr par ridā
moze pahan ke god meñ shabbīr ko liyā
dar tak ga.ī jo ghar se vo dil-band-e-mustafā
fizza ne baḌh ke būzar o salmāñ ko dī sadā
pesh-e-nabī husain ko godī meñ laatī haiñ
haT jaao sab ki fātima masjid meñ aatī haiñ
allāh-re aamad āmad-e-zehrā kā bandobast
sātoñ falak the auj-e-sharāfat se jis ke past
ahmad ke gird-o-pesh se uTThe ḳhudā-parast
insāñ to kyā malak ko na thī qudarat-e-nishast
aa.iiñ to shād-shād rasūl-e-zaman hue
ghar meñ ḳhudā ke ek jagah panj-tan hue
tāzīm-e-fātima ko uThe sayyad-ul-bashar
dekhā ki chashm-e-fātima hai āñsuoñ se tar
ġham the husain dosh pe maañ ke jhukā.e sar
thā ik hilāl mahr ke pahlū meñ jalva-gar
maañ kahtī thī na rovo magar chup na hote the
āñkheñ thiiñ band hichkiyāñ le le ke rote the
ghabrā ke pūchhne lage mahbūb-e-zul-jalāl
rotā hai kyuuñ husain ye kyā hai tumhārā haal
bolīñ butūl aaj qalaq hai mujhe kamāl
royā hai ye husain ki āñkheñ haiñ donoñ laal
aate haiñ hañste rote hue ghar meñ jaate haiñ
shafqat bhī aap hī karte haiñ aap hī rulāte haiñ
hāthoñ ko joḌtī huuñ maiñ yā shāh-e-bahr-o-bar
shafqat kī us ke haal pe har-dam rahe nazar
rone se us ke hotā hai TukḌe mirā jigar
mujh fāqa-kash ġharīb kā pyārā hai ye pisar
haidar se pūchhiye mire usrat ke haal ko
kis kis dukhoñ se paalā hai is naunihāl ko
ashk us ke jitne Tapke haiñ yā shāh-e-nek-ḳhū
utnā hī ghaT gayā hai mire jism kā lahū
ro.e haiñ phuuT phuuT ke ye mere rū-ba-rū
tar ho gayā hai āñsuoñ se chāñd sā gulū
dekhā na thā ye maiñ ne jo haal is kā aaj hai
hazrat to jānte haiñ ki nāzuk mizāj hai
shafqat se aaj aap ne chūme hasan ke lab
bosa liyā na un ke laboñ kā ye kyā sabab
rutbe meñ donoñ ek haiñ yā survar-e-arab
maiñ sach kahūñ ye sun ke mujhe bhī huā ojab
is ko jo ho ḳhushī to dil is kā bhī shaad ho
chhoTe se chāhiye ki mohabbat ziyād ho
aap un ke naaz uThāte haiñ yā shāh-e-bahr-o-bar
phir kis se rūTheñ aap se rūTheñ na ye agar
aksar inheñ chaḌhāyā hai hazrat ne dosh par
gesū diye haiñ nanhe se hāthoñ meñ besh-tar
rūThe the ye so qadmoñ pe sar dharne aa.e haiñ
muñh ke na chūmne kā gilā karne aa.e haiñ
ye kah ke phir husain se bolīñ ba-chashm-tar
lo jā ke ab nabī ke qadam par jhukāo sar
aa.e husain haath jo nanhe se joḌ kar
be-iḳhtiyār rone lage sayyad-ul-bashar
rah rah ke dekhte the alī o butūl ko
nazdīk thā qalaq se ġhash aa.e rasūl ko
thī āñsuoñ se rīsh-e-mubārak tamām nam
fart-e-bukā se ḳhaak pa jhukte the dam-ba-dam
gaahe sutūñ se lag ke hue raast gaah ḳham
har lahza iztirāb ziyāda thā sabr kam
ho saktā thā na zabt shah-e-mashriqain se
rote the baar baar lipaT kar husain se
shabbīr ro ke kahte the naanā na roiye
ro.eñge ab na ham shah-e-vālā na roiye
hilne lagegā arsh-e-muallā na roiye
phaTtā hai ab hamārā kaleja na roiye
sau baar din meñ ham to muñh ashkoñ se dhote haiñ
hazrat hamāre rone pe kaahe ko rote haiñ
ghabrā ga.e alī-e-valī shāh-e-bahr-o-bar
kī arz fātima ne jhukā ke qadam pe sar
beTī nisār ho ga.ī yā sayyad-ul-bashar
kyā vaj.h hai jo aap haiñ is tarah nauha gar
jaldī batā.iye ki mujhe taab ab nahīñ
ronā ḳhudā ke dost kā ye be-sabab nahīñ
hazrat ko ilm-e-ġhaib hai yā shāh-e-ins-o-jāñ
ā.inda o guzishta kā sab haal hai ayaañ
kyā aa.ī aaj vahī-e-ḳhudāvand-e-do-jahāñ
honā hai jo husain pe mujh se karo bayāñ
fāqoñ se kāTtī huuñ musībat jahān kī
kyuuñ bāba-jān ḳhair to hai is kī jaan kī
bole jigar ko thaam ke mahbūb-e-zul-jalāl
tujh se sunā na jā.egā ai fātima ye haal
kis muñh se maiñ kahūñ ki qalaq hai mujhe kamāl
zehrā shahīd hue hoveñge tere ye donoñ laal
mātam kī ye ḳhabar abhī jibrīl laa.e the
saare malak husain ke purse ko aa.e the
almās pī ke huegā be-jāñ tirā hasan
ye vaj.h hai ki chūmtā huuñ us kā maiñ dahan
bhar jā.egā kalejoñ ke TukḌoñ se sab lagan
hogā zamurradī tire is laal kā badan
sū-e-bahisht jab ye jahāñ se sidhāreñge
bad-kesh tiir is ke janāze pa māreñge
zehrā mujhe kalām kī tāqat nahīñ hai ab
halq-e-husain chūmne kā kyā kahūñ sabab
ik ban meñ tiin roz raheñge ye tishna-lab
kaT jā.egā galā yahī ḳhanjar se hai ġhazab
neze pe sar chaḌhegā tire nūr-e-ain kā
ghoḌoñ se rauñd Dāleñge lāsha husain kā
ro.e ḳhabar ye kah ke jo mahbūb-e-zul-minan
ghabrā ke muñh husain kā takne lage hasan
zehrā pukārī haa.e luTegā mirā chaman
maiñ mar ga.ī duhā.ī hai yā sarvar-e-zaman
ye kaisī aag hai ki mirī kokh jal ga.ī
hai hai chhurī kaleje pe zehrā ke chal ga.ī
fariyād yā-nabī shah-e-abrār al-ġhiyās
ai mursilān-e-haq ke madad-gār al-ġhiyās
ai be-kasoñ ke vāris o sardār ul-ġhiyās
qudarat hai sab tarah kī shah-e-mashriqain ko
hazrat se lūñgī apne hasan aur husain ko
kis jurm par ye laal mire qatl hoñge aah
ro kar kahā rasūl-e-ḳhudā ne ki be-gunāh
kī arz fātima ne ki ai arsh-e-bār-gāh
bachchoñ ko mere kyā na milegī kahīñ panāh
talvāreñ kheñch kheñch ke zālim jo ā.eñge
hazrat na kyā navāsoñ ko apne bachā.eñge
āsāñ hai kyā jo qatl kareñge sitam-shi.ār
kyā sher-e-haq kamar se na khīñcheñge zul-fiqār
aadā pe kyā chalegā na dast-e-ḳhudā kā vaar
bāloñ ko kyā na kholegī zehrā jigar figār
TukḌe jigar jo huegā mujh dil do-nīm kā
paaya na kyā hilā.ūñgī arsh-e-azīm kā
zehrā se ro ke kahne lage shāh-e-nek-ḳhū
beTī mujhe satā.eñge turbat meñ kīna-jū
is vaqt qatl hoveñge ye donoñ māh-rū
duniyā meñ jab na hogā alī aur na maiñ na tū
lāshe pe mujtabā ke tū shabbīr ro.egā
shabbīr jab maregā to koī na huegā
chillā.ī sar paTak ke ye zehrā ki hai sitam
pīTegā kaun tan se jo niklegā us kā dam
mātam kī saf bichhā.egā kaun ai shah-e-umama
purse ko kaun aa.egā us ke ba-chashm-e-nam
ham meñ se aise vaqt jo koī na huegā
hai hai mire husain ko phir kaun ro.egā
bachche kī mere tāziya-dārī karegā kaun
muñh Dhāñp Dhāñp girya-o-zārī karegā kaun
dariyā-e-ashk chashm se jaarī karegā kaun
imdād bād-e-marg hamārī karegā kaun
hogā kahāñ nabī ke navāse kā fātiha
sharbat pe kaun devegā pyāse kā fātiha
bole nabī ki aap ko zehrā na kar halāk
farmā chukā hai mujh se ye va.ada ḳhudā-e-pāk
paidā kareñge qaum ik aisī ba-rū-e-ḳhāk
jo raat din raheñge isī ġham meñ dard-nāk
bazm-e-azā meñ ā.eñge vo duur duur se
tan ḳhaak se banā.eñge dil un ke nuur se
hogī unhīñ se majlis-e-mātam kī zeb-o-zain
deñge unheñ vo lab ki rahe jis pe vā husain
āñkheñ vo deñge rone ko samjheñ jo farz-e-ain
haath aise ġhair sīna-zanī ho jinheñ na chain
sāmān tāziyat ke kabhī kam na hoveñge
vo hashr tak husain ke mātam meñ ro.eñge
hogā ayaañ falak pe moharram kā jab hilāl
raḳht-e-siyāh pahneñge bar meñ vo ḳhush-ḳhisāl
kholeñgī bībayāñ bhī sab apne saroñ ke baal
har ghar meñ hogā shor ki hai hai alī kā laal
leñge sile meñ ḳhuld tire nūr-e-ain se
aañsū aziiz vo na kareñge husain se
pyāsā shahīd hogā jo terā ye dil-rubā
momin sabīleñ rakkheñge paanī kī jā-ba-jā
hovegī shaad ruuh shahīdān-e-karbalā
bhar bhar ke āb-e-sard pukāreñge barmalā
mahbūb-e-kibriyā ke navāse kī nazr hai
pyāse na jā.iyo ki ye pyāse kī nazr hai
kahne lagī nabī se butūl-e-falak-janāb
hai hai maiñ kyā karūñ mire dil ko nahīñ hai taab
ai bādshāh-e-kaun-o-makāñ mālikur-riqāb
dargāh-e-haq meñ aap kī hai arz mustajāb
kiije duā ki ḳhāliq-e-akbar madad kare
allāh ye balā mire bachche kī rad kare
beTī se ro ke kahne lage shāh-e-kā.enāt
rūh-ul-amīñ ne mujh se to ye bhī kahī hai baat
chāho to rad kare ye balā rabb-e-pāk-zāt
lekin na huegī mire ummat kī phir najāt
mahbūb-e-haq nisār tire nūr-e-ain par
mauqūf hai ye amar to qatl-e-husain par
allāh-re sabr-e-mahbūb-e-kirdgār
ummat kā naam sun ke jhukāyā sar ek baar
ḳhush-nūd ho ke kahne lage shāh-e-zul-fiqār
sadqe hasan husain tasadduq alī nisār
is raah meñ na maal na daulat aziiz hai
pyāre pisar nahīñ hameñ ummat aziiz hai
kahne lage husain se phir shāh-e-bahr-o-bar
batlā mujhe ki kyā tirī marzī hai ai pisar
naanā se bole chhoTe se hāthoñ ko joḌ kar
ummat ke kaam aa.e to hāzir abhī hai sar
va.ada ko ham na bhūleñge go ḳhurd-sāl haiñ
chhoTe nahīñ haiñ muḳhbir-e-sādiq ke laal haiñ
rote haiñ aap kis liye yā sayyad-e-umam
raazī haiñ ham pe rāh-e-ḳhudā meñ hoñ jo sitam
talvāreñ bhī chaleñ to nahīñ mārne ke dam
ummat pe apne sar ko tasadduq kareñge ham
ham rāst-go haiñ baat pe jis vaqt aate haiñ
kahte haiñ jo zabāñ se vahī kar dikhāte haiñ
bachpan meñ jo zabāñ se kahā thā kiyā vo kaam
jis vaqt ran meñ TuuT paḌe shah pe fauj-e-shām
gardan jhukā ke barchhiyāñ khāyā kiye imaam
ḳhuuñ meñ qabā rasūl kī tar ho ga.ī tamām
teġheñ alī ke laal ke shāne pe chal ga.iiñ
chhātī ke paar nezoñ kī nokeñ nikal ga.iiñ
pherī na thī jo pusht-e-mubārak dam-e-masāf
the do hazār zaḳhm faqat sar se tā-ba-nāf
sayyad se be-vatan se zamāna thā bar-ḳhilāf
ġhul thā ki aaj hotā hai ghar fātima kā saaf
sambhlā na jā.egā ḳhalaf-e-bū-turāb se
lo vo qadam husain ke nikle rikāb se
meñh kī tarah barasne lage shāh-e-dīñ pe tiir
tharrā rahe the lag ke tan-e-nāznīñ pe tiir
dāman pe tiir jaib pe tiir āstīñ pe tiir
pahlū pe teġh siina pe neza jabīñ pe tiir
dāġhoñ se ḳhuuñ ke raḳht-e-badan lāla-zār thā
shakl-e-zarīh sīna-e-aqdas figār thā
tar thī lahū meñ zulf-e-shikan-dar-shikan judā
majrūh lāl-e-lab the judā aur dahan judā
darpai the neza-dār judā teġhzan judā
kaT kaT ke ho gayā thā har ik uzv-e-tan judā
sī-pāra thā na sadr faqat us janāb kā
purze varaq-varaq thā ḳhudā kī kitāb kā
kartā thā vaar barchhiyoñ vāloñ kā jab parā
teġhoñ se dam bhī lene kī mohlat na thī zarā
nezoñ meñ ḳhuuñ nabī ke navāse kā thā bharā
shamshīr-o-tīr neza-o-ḳhanjar ke māvarā
thiiñ saḳhtiyāñ sitam kī shah-e-ḳhush-ḳhisāl par
chalte the sañg fāima-zehrā ke laal par
the do hazār jism-e-shah-e-bahr-o-bar pe zaḳhm
māthe pe zaḳhm tiir ke teġhoñ ke sar pe zaḳhm
gardan pe zaḳhm siine pe zaḳhm aur kamar pe zaḳhm
aur is ke māvarā the bahattar jigar pe zaḳhm
ghoḌe pe gah sambhalte the gah Dagmagāte the
ġhash aatā thā to hirne pe sar ko jhukāte the
ghoḌe pe jab sambhalne kī mutlaq rahī na taab
hāthoñ se baag chhūT ga.ī aur paañv se rikāb
girne lagā jo ḳhaak pe vo āsmāñ-janāb
marqad meñ be-qarār huī rūh-e-bū-turāb
ġhul thā ki ḳhaak par shah-e-kaun-o-makāñ girā
bas ab zamīñ ulaT ga.ī aur āsmāñ girā
jaltī huī zamīñ pe taḌapne lage imaam
be-kas pe zālimoñ ne kiyā aur izhdihām
us vaqt shimr se ye umar ne kiyā kalām
haañ tan se jald kaaT sar-e-sarvar-e-anām
dariyo na sun ke fāima-zehrā kī aah ko
gul kar de sham-e-qabr-e-risālat-panāh ko
ye sunte hī chaḌhā.ī sitam-gar ne āstīñ
ḳhanjar kamar se khīñch ke aage baḌhā liiñ
the qibla-rū jhuke hue sajde meñ shāh-e-dīñ
lab hilte dekhe shaah ke aayā vo jab qarīñ
samjhā ki tishnagī se jo sadme guzarte haiñ
us vaqt bad-duā mujhe shabbīr karte haiñ
jhuk kar qarīb kaan jo laayā to ye sunā
haq meñ gunāhgāroñ ke karte haiñ shah duā
jaarī zabān-e-ḳhushk pe ye hai ki ai ḳhudā
kar hājatoñ ko mere muhibboñ kī to ravā
shī.oñ kā hashr roz-e-jazā mere saath ho
merā ye ḳhūñ-bahā hai ki un kī najāt ho
ye sun ke musta.id huā vo shah ke qatl par
zaanū rakhā husain ke siine pa be-ḳhatar
gardan pe pherne lagā ḳhanjar jo bad-guhar
aa.ī sadā alī kī ki hai hai mire pisar
zehrā pukārī kuchh bhī nabī se hijāb hai
zālim ye bosa-gāh-e-risālat-ma.āb hai
kyuuñ zab.h mere laal ko kartā hai be-gunāh
kyuuñ kāTtā hai mere kaleje ko rū-siyāh
kashtī ko ahl-e-bait-e-nabī kī na kar tabāh
maiñ fātima huuñ arsh hilā.egī merī aah
huegā hashr qatl jo ye be-vatan huā
ye mar gayā to ḳhātma-e-panj-tan huā
āvāz apnī maañ kī ye zainab ne jab sunī
dauḌī nikal ke ḳheme se sar pīTtī huī
dekhā ki zab.h kartā hai hazrat ko vo shaqī
sar piiT kar ye kahne lagī vo jigar-jalī
hai hai na tiin roz ke pyāse ko zab.h kar
zālim na mustafā ke navāse ko zab.h kar
baano pukārtī thī ye kyā kartā hai la.iiñ
pyāsā hai tiin roz se haidar kā jā-nashīñ
chillātī thī sakīna ki jiine kī maiñ nahīñ
baabā ko zab.h kartā hai kyuuñ ai udū-e-dīñ
ḳhanjar na pher chāñd sī gardan pe rahm kar
abbā ko chhoḌ de mire bachpan pe rahm kar
zaḳhmoñ se chuur chuur hai zehrā kā yādgār
jis chhātī par meñ sotī thī us par hai to savār
baabā ke halq par na phirā ab chhurī kī dhaar
badle pidar ke sar ko mare tan se tū utaar
sayyad pe tishna-lab pe sitam is qadar na kar
potī huuñ fātima kī mujhe be-pidar na kar
ro kar bayāñ ye kartī thī vo soḳhta-jigar
de kar duhā.ī ahl-e-haram pīTte the sar
kartā thā zab.h shah ko vahāñ shimr-e-bad guhar
farmāte the ye shaah ki pyāsā huuñ rahm kar
paanī diyā na haa.e nabī ke navāse ko
jallād zab.h karne lagā bhūke pyāse ko
āḳhir sar-e-imām-e-umam tan se kaT gayā
chillā ke fātima ne ye zainab ko dī sadā
maidāñ se jald le ke sakīna ko ghar meñ jā
be-jurm kaT gayā tire maañ jaa.e kā galā
maarā ba-zulm shimr ne pyāse ko jaan se
maiñ laT ga.ī husain sidhāre jahān se
bas ai ‘anīs’ bazm meñ hai nāla-o-fuġhāñ
pūchh un ke dil se jo haiñ suḳhan-fahm nukta-dāñ
haq hai sunā nahīñ kabhī us husn kā bayāñ
goyā ki ye ḳhalīq kī hai sar-ba-sar zabāñ
sach hai ki is zabāñ ko koī jāntā nahīñ
jo jāntā hai aur ko vo māntā nahīñ

items.title: Jab bhi chadar ki taraf utti nazar sajjad ki
items.body:
JAB BHI CHAADAR KI TARAF UTTI NAZAR SAJJAD KI X2
TAAZIYAANE CHOONAY AAYI KAMAR SAJJAD KI
NOK E NEZA PE RIDAAEN DEKH KE KHATA HEY GHASH
YEH BHI MANZAR DEKH KAR ABBID KO AAJATA HAY GHASH
SAAMNE GHURBAT PHUPHI HAI NANGY SAR SAJAD KI
HAQ E GIRY A YUN ADAA KARTY TH LE KE SHEH KA NAAM
KARBALA SE SHAAM THAK ITNA LAHOO ROEY IMAM
KHOON MEI TAR HO GAYI RAAH E SAFAR SAJAD KI
SABR KA HAR IMTEHAAN BEHR E KHUDA DENEH KE BAAD
KHA GAYA GHASH WA HIJABA KI SADA DENEH KE BAAD
JAB PARI SAR PAR PHUPHI KE IK NAZAR SAJAD KI
ZULM JAB BARNE LAGEH APNI HADON SE BHI MAZEED
JAB IMAM E WAQT KO KARNEH LAGA ZAALIM SHAHEED
BAN GAYI DARBAAR MEI ZAINAB SIPAR SAJAD KI
HA BAQAIYA MEI BHALA SAJAD KAB AARAAM MEI
JISAM AABID KA MADINY MEI HEY DIL HAY SHAAM MEI
DAFN HEY ZIDAAN MAI IK NOHA GAR SAJAD KI
SAJDA E MABOOD MEI JUKTEY TH JAB IBN E HUSSAIN
KHINCTI HAI ZANJIR AATEY TH SAKINA KE YE BAIN
THI NAMAZ E KHOON KE ASHKO SE TAR SAJAD KI
KARBALA SE SHAAM TAKH BABA KO BAS ROTEH RAHEY
AUR BAAD E SHAAM CHADAR KE LIYE AANSU BAHEY
UMR SAARI HO GAYI YOUHI BASAR SAJAD KI
JAB BHI DORAN E SAFAR BEHTHY ASAD THAK KAR IMAM
YOUH SITAMGAARO NE BEJAA KA LIA HEY INTEQAAM
BEHRIYA KHENCHI GAYI BAAE E DIGAR SAJAD KI

items.title: Leke maula ka naam zainab ka
items.body:
Leke maula ka naam zainab ka
likh raha hu kalam zainab ka
Sub pe wajib hai saath zahra ke
karna bas ehteram zainab ka
Farsh e majlis hussain maula ki
hai ye sub intezaam zainab ka
Ambiyao'n se hur ye kehne laga
mujhko aaya salam zainab ka
Mashwera deti hai imamo ko
allah allah maqam zainab ka
Naaz tujhko bhi hoga kismat pe
tu bhi banja ghulam zainab ka
Kaa'np utthega qalb batil ka
sunke zor e kalam zainab ka
Sar se chadar na hatne paye kabhi
sunlo behno payam zainab ka
Padhta rehta hu mai qasida zaheer
raat din subho sham zainab ka

items.title: Main Bewaye Muslim Hon Mera Naam
items.body:
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
ghazi ki behan hu mai haider as mera baba hai
1.  HOKE BERBAAD MEIN KIS TERHA SE WATAN JAWOUNGI
DAAGH MUSLIM KA MEIN IS DIL PE NA SEH PAWOUNGI
HUM PE DHAYE HAI MAZALIM JO MUSALMANO NE
JAKE NANA KI LEHAD PER MEIN WO BATLAWOUNGI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI,
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOON MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAAM RUQAYYA HAI
2.  MARA GAYA HAI LOGO GHURBAT MERA WAALI
MERI MANG BHI HAI UJDI AGHOSH BHI HAI KHAALI
KARBOBALA SE PEHLE GHER MERA LUT GAYA HAI
3. MAA NE HAI BACHPANE SE HUMKO WAFA SIKHAYI
GHAZI KI ZINDAGI MEIN SHEHH PE NA ANCH AAYI
ZAINAB KA SATH MENE HER GAAM NIBHAYA HAI
4. DO PHOOL JAISE BACCHE ANKHO KE MERI TAARE
BABA KE SATH DONO GHURBAT MEIN GAYE MAARE
AUN AUR MOHAMMED PE UNKO KIYA SADQA HAI
5. MUSLIM PE KUFIYO NE KYA KYA SITAM NA DHAYE
DHOKE SE KIYA HUMLA SHOLEY BHI HAI BERSAYE
GARDAN MEIN RASAN BANDHI GALIYO MEIN PHIRAYA HAI
6. MARO NA TAZIYANE ZAINAB KO AYE LAYEENO
LILLAH HA NA SATAWO AHMED KI NAWASI KO
PEHCHANO MUSALMANO YE SANIYE ZEHRA HAI
7. MEIN KAISE BHOOL JAWO WO DARDNAAK MANZAR
KUFE KE DAR PE DEKHI MUSLIM KI LASH BE SAR
MAZLOOM KI GHURBAT PE DIL MERA PHAT GAYA HAI
8. ISLAAM PE RAHEGA AHSAAN GHUMZADA KA
QURBANIYA HAI JISKI AGHAAZ KARBALA KA
ANKHO MEIN JISKA AANSO AWAAZ DERAHA HAI
9. KYO KER RAQAM HO MANZAR KAISE PADHE SHUJAYAT
BIBI KE DIL PE GUZRI KUFE MEIN JO QAYAMAT
TADPI HAI LAASHE MUSLIM BIBI NE JAB KAHA HAI
MEIN BEWAYE MUSLIM HOON MERA NAME RUQAYYA HAI
GHAZI KI BEHAN HOO MEIN HYDER MERA BABA HAI

items.title: Qaid e Sitam Main Ro Kar
items.body:
Qaide Sitam me ro ker kahti h ye sakina
Beti ki kuch khabar lo aaker shahe madina
Baad apke jaha'n ne wo zulm Mujhpe dhaya,
Her lamha ghudkiya di her gaam pe rulaya
Kisko sunaye apni [2] roodad ye hazina
Serab kr rhe hain naqo ko bhi sitamgar
Dete Nahi mujhe per ik boond baniye shar,
Is tashnagi se baba [2] mar jau mai kahin na
Barbad hogye hum Is sar zamee'n pe aake,
Ghar baar haye ujda mera ye jis tarah se,
Ujde kisi ka kunba [2] is tarha se kbhi na
Hansti hai Mujhpe baba dariyawon ki rawani,
Ammu bhi ab nahi hain laye jo jake pani,
Taqdeer me faqat hai [2] ab mere Ashk pina,
Raas aayi na jawani haye mere Akhi ko,
Roti hu yaad kr k besheer ki hansi ko,
Ik din me Karbala ne [2] kya kya na Humse cheena,
Tum Chhod k gaye ho dashte bala me jabse,
Soyi nahi sakina ik pal ko baba tabse,
Na nind hai moyassar [2] na apka wo sina
Aata nahi hai koi is qaid se chhudane
Khane ko mil rhe hain zalim k taziyane
Logo ne krdiya hai [2] dushwar mera jeena
Kahti thi aye nadeemo soohail roke muztar,
Is zindagi se baba to mout hi hai Behtar
Baqi nahi hai koi [2] jeene ka ab Qareena

items.title: Tabarra suno
items.body:
1 ) Main tabbara hun wo mazloom ibadat main hun
Seenae sabr py utri hue ayat main hun
Daar pr hazrat e mesum ki khitabat main hun
Is liye aaj bhi hr rukh sy salamat main hun
Meri takhleeq hue dushman e zehra k liye
Mot hun aaj bhi main bint e saqeefa k liye
2 ) Haif sad haif k apno ny sataya mjhko
Or islah k parday main chupaya mujhko
Main tasadum hun ye keh keh k rulaya mjhko
Main ibadat tha magar aib bataya mujhko
Naam badnaam jahan sab ny kiya hy mera
Haq prasto ny wahan sath diya hy mera
3 ) khas bando py hi khaliq ki inayat main hun
Main hi masjid hun musala hun ibadat main hun
Khutba e bagh e fidak ki wo ibarat main hun
Jiski zehra hy azan uski iqamat main hun
Khush nasab jitny hain afrad sabhi jnty hain
Mera mayar bilal e habashi janty hain
4 ) chor kr mjhko musaly py jabin kuch bhi nhi
In namazo me agr me hi nhi kuch bhi nhi
Bughz mera hy to makky ki zamee kuch bhi nhi
Gar tabbara hi nhi hy to kahin kuch bhi nhi
Ishq e haider ko tabbary sy junoo milta hy
Mery hony si hi momin ko sukoo milta hy
5 ) qulho Allah mein or surae yaseen mein hun
Jo hy khaliq ka pasandeeda usi deen main hun
Me farishto ki duaon main hun ameen main hun
Tujhko maloom nhi hy k main talqeen main hun
Qabr main jaky ye jano gy tabarra kia hy
Mot k baad ye mano gy tabarra kia hy
6 ) pooch rawi sy riwayat main tabarra kiun hy
Kalma e haq ki shahadat main tabarra kiun hy
Pooch ayat sy k ayat main tabbara kiun hy
Asr e ashoor ziarat me tabbara kiun hy
Dushman e deen ko ye tana e abtar kia hy
Pooch quran sy ye surae kosar kia hy
7 ) ye btao k aqeedy ko bachana hy gunnah
Kia fazail k samandar mai nahana hy gunnah
Dasta’n haq ki zamany ko sunana hy gunah
Kis sy naraz thin zahra ye batana hy gunnah
Aik aik zakhm ka badla to liya jaega
Lakh rokogy tabbara to kiya jaega

items.title: Abbas ke baghair bhala kaise chalungi
items.body:
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Baba nay kaha paidal tu chalna seekh lay
Aik din ai ga tu paidal chalay gi
Meelon ka safar tanha bay chadar karay gi
Zainab nay kaha Baba aik baat toh batana (×2)
18 baradar hain (×2) ma paidal kiun chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Hae Karbobala ma phir wo din aa gea
Hussain peh Zalim ka khanjar chal gea
Khaimon ma shaki naizay lay k aa gea
Pabanday rasan ho k bazaron ma jana (×2)
Naizon peh sar hain (×2) ma kaisay chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon gi
Sajjad say yun kehnay lagien Zainab e Kubra
Chalna ma nay seekha tha ghar ma he tanha
Lakin ab hai yeh shaam ka bazaar
Shermo haya ki malka ma Zainab hoon (×2)
Chadar k baghair (×2) ma kesay chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon
Shaam k darbaar ma Zainab ka ana tha
Islam e Muhammad ko is nay he bachana tha
Darbarion ko huq bhi toh sunana tha
Lehja e Haider ma yun booli Zainab (×2)
Nasir e Hussain (×2) ma yun ban ker chalon gi
Abbas k bagahir bhala kesay chalon

items.title: Aina mahdi e zaman
items.body:
Ya Mahdi, Ya Mahdi, Ya Mahdi..(2)
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mujhme taqwa wo nahi kaisr Ammar banu
mujhme taqat wo nahi mai bhi Mukhtar banu
Pisar e Fatema, na mai meesum hi bana
Karbala mein jo bane aisa kirdaar banu
Maula,
Aaj tak aapki nusrat mein kiya kuch bhi nahi
Mere daaman mein gunaho ke siwa kuch bhi nahi
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kab hai Buzar ki tarha, kab hai Qambar ka hasham
Garche maujood nahi hum mein Salmaan ka dam

Aapke jadd ki qasam haan azadaar hai hum
Maula,
Aap to aaj bhi mazloom e bila nasir hai
Maula hum aapki nusrat ke liye hazir hai
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>

Maalo shohrat bhi fida, ye zamee'n aur makaa'n
Pisar e Fatema, jis pe qurbaan ho maa
Tu ishara to kare tujhpe qurbaan ho jaa'n
Maula,
Baare sar gosh pe lekar mai kidhar jaunga
Maula gar aap na aaye to mai marr jaunga
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aakhri saas talak aapke saath hai hum
Aapko dekha nahi phir bhi hai ek hi ghum
Pisar e Fatema, sahib e lauh o qalam
Mai hu majboor magar jaane maula ki qasam
Maula,
Kuch nahi chahiye maula mujhe duniya ki sanad
Ye meri aakhri hichki hai meri aakhri hadd
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)

Maaein zainab ki tarah dil ko mazboot kare
Pisar e Fatema, hum bhi zalim se lade
Khatm ghaibat ho agar, sue kaaba bhi chale
Maula,
Ye tamanna hai ke ye jaam shahadat ka piye
Maao'n ne paala hai bacho ko isi din ke liye
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Muntazir rehte hai hum, hum hai maula ke ghulam
Naukri humko mile, hum kare aapke kaam
Pisar e Fatema, aap par mera salaam
Dete taane hai adu, hai kaha'n tera imam
Maula,
Mehr jab parda e ghaibat se nikal aayega
Bachke takfiri koi bhi ye kidhar jayega
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)

Jhooth, gheebat hai ghina, raks iblees ka jaal

Kyu kamate hi nahi log ye rizq e halaal

Zindagi karb e musalsal se nikal jayegi
Aap aajaye to duniya ye badal jayegi
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..
Aina Mahdi e zama'n, aina maula e jaha'n..(2)

Ek baar aapka bus dekhlu chehra maula
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..

Aaiye shaam ke darbaar ka badla lene
Aajaye naa yabna nabi..

Shaam hai girya kuna, hai sakina tanha

Aaj bhi qaid me hai shahe madina ke liye

Aajaye naa yabna nabi..
Aajaye naa yabna ali..

items.title: Aye Akbar
items.body:
Umme Laila Ne Kaha Ey Mere Noor e Nazar
Ey Mere Lakhte Jigar Ey Akbar
Mai Na Bhulungi Kabhi Zulm Ki vo Barchi or tera zakhme jigar ey akbar
Hasrto aas ke tufan liye baithi thi
Mai Tere byah ka armaan liye baithi thi
ye khabar mujhko na thi ek din dekhungi
Mai tujhe khoon Mai tar ey akbar
Mujhko Taqdeer agar din vo dikhati beta
Tera sehra Mai duaon say sajati beta
Mere hum shakle nabi Karti dum naad e Ali
Mai Tere sehre par ey akbar
Mere yusuf teri Barat na jaane payi
Rang hai teri dulhan Ghar Mai na aane payi
Kohey Ghum Yo'n tuta sath tera chuta
Lut gaya Mera Ghar ey akbar
Ey mere Noor e Nazar lakhte Jigar meri jaa'n
Dekhlu teri dulhan Dil Mai yahi tha arma'n
Khwab jo they mere ho na paste purey
Phat gaya Mera jigar ey akbar
Maine rakkha hai Tere byah ka silkar
Kaise rakhhungi bhala ab Mai jigar par Patthar
Zindagi guzregi ab toe is madar ki
Raat din Rorokar ey akbar
Ey mere Lal tujhe bhool na paungi Mai
Ashk aakhon say dino raat bahaungi Mai
Zindagi hai Jub Tak mere pyare tab Tak
Roungi Mai tujh par ey akbar
Sath pardes Mai amma ka na chhodo pyare
Maa say mooh esy gharibi may na modo pyare
Mere naazo ke paley uth ke lag jao galey
Hai pareshaN madar ey akbar
Bain Karti rahi Akbar vo ghamo ki pyari
Rokey waiz ye sada Deti rahi dukhyari
Mar Gaye tum beta rehgai Mai zinda
Ab jiyu'n ghutghut kar ey akbar

items.title: Koi na raha sannata hai
items.body:
Koi na raha sannata hai
Maqtal se yahi aati thi sada, koi na raha sannata hai
Pardes mein aakar kaun luta, koi na raha sannata hai
Allah ye kaisa manzar hai, jo laash bhi hai wo besar hai..(2)
behta hai yaha'n khoo'n ka darya, koi na raha sannata hai
Hai aaj fezaae'n bhi ghamgee'n, laasho'n ke sarhane koi nahi..(2)
chhayi hai falak par gham ki ghata, koi na raha sannata hai
Kuch khaime nazar aate hai jale, aur sukhe huwe toote kooze..(2)
kya qafela tha ye pyaaso ka, koi na raha sannata hai
Ye laash hai kis shehzade ki, kis tarha hua seena zakhmi..(2)
qismat ne sitam kis maa pe kiya, koi na raha sannata hai
Hai qadd mein barabar do laashe, doobe hai lahu ke darya mein..(2)
dono ko ajal ne loot liya, koi na raha sannata hai
Ye maara gaya hai kaun hasee'n, sehra hai kahin kangna hai kahin..(2)
kaisa ye sitam duniya ne kiya, koi na raha sannata hai
Ek sher pada hai sahil par, haibat ka abhi tak ye hai asar..(2)
sehmi sehmi chalti hai hawa, koi na raha sannata hai
Har simt udaasi chhayi hai, teero'n pe kise neend aayi hai..(2)
Be goro kafan laasha hai pada, koi na raha sannata hai
Maqtal se yahi aati thi sada, koi na raha sannata hai

items.title: Main Dekh Rahi Hu
items.body:
Dekha jo apne bhai ka kat ta hua gala
Sattar kadam se zainab e muztar ne di sada
Bhai ka gala hai aur sitamgar ka khanjar mai dekh rahi hoon
amma ne rakha hai haath gale par ro ro kar mai dekh rahi hoon
tum kehte rahe jisko moula khanjar k tale wo bhai hai
aye bhai kaha ho aa jao shabbir pe ghurbat aayi hai
abbas tumhara naam hai bhai lab par mai dekh rahi hoon
ahmed ke nawase par haaye kya waqt e qayamat aaya hai
chuma tha mohammed ne jisko uss halq pe khanjar chalta hai
ye karbobla mein aj qayamat ka manzar mai dekh rahi hoon
zakhmi hai badan haaye mere bhai sa koi mazloom nahi
sehrooz k pyase hai sarwar kya shimr ko ye maloom nahi
karta hai sitamgar waar gale par gin gin kar mai dekh rahi hoon
Manoos hai apne baba se bichdegi toh jee na paayegi
shamsheer gale par baba ke wo dekhte hi marr jaayegi
maidan mei na aajaye sakina mud mud kar mai dekh rahi hoon
pardes mein haaye ye kaisi saadat pe ghurbat aayi hai
hadd kardi sitam ki zaalim ne lagta hai qayamat aayi hai
hai shimr ka zaanu ibne ali k seene par mai dekh rahi hoon
bikhre hue baalon mein haaye buss khaak hi khaak nazar aaye
aakhon se baraste hai aansoon aur hooton par haaye haaye
iss haal pe pehli baar nazar aayi'n madar mai dekh rahi hoon
zeeshan aur arshad roota tha zainab ke haal pe sara run
bhai ke gale par tegh chali aur kehti rahi ro ro ke behen
hota hua run mein apne baradar ko be sar mai dekh rahi hoon

items.title: Ravi Karta Hai Bayan
items.body:

Aap jabse hain Madine se sidhare baba
Dhundle dhundle nazar aate hain nazare baba..

Waqt e Ruksat ye kaha tha mai zarur aaunga
Baith jati hu mai darwaze pe har subho masa
Intezar unka mai Karti hu abhi tak baba..

Mujh ko acha nahi lagta ye zamana bhaiyya

Lashe Akbar Jahan rakhi thi wahan ja pahoche
Rakh ke khat seena e Akbar pe Shahe deen bole
Utho Akbar tumhe Sughra ka payam aaya hai

Kon us Khat ka Jawab us ghadi deta Majid
Qafela Qaid se Yasrab me jo Pahocha Majid
Ek Abid ke siwa koi na lauta Majid
Mil gaya khud hi jawab e Khat e Sughra Majid

items.title: Tumko Deta Hoo Mein Baba Ki Duhai Bhai
items.body:

Mujhko Ek Baar Toh Keh Do Mere Bhai ...Bhai

1. Issle Pehle Ki Talaatum Koi Barpa Ho Jaye
Isse Pehle Ke Lahu Rang Ye Dariya Ho Jaye

2. Isse Pehle Ki Phir Ek Arsh Ka Taara Toote

Isse Pehle Ki Tera Sath Aye Bhai Choote
Tumko Deta Hoo Mai Baba Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaanta Hai Ye Zamana Ke Wafadar Ho Tum

Mujhse Pehle Hi Magar Marne Ko Taiyaar Ho Tum
Tumko Deta Hoo Mai Baba Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tumne Jo Haqq E Wafa Tha Wo Nibhaya Abbas
Tumne Baba Ki Hidayat Ko Maana Abbas
Tumne Qadmon Pe Mere Sar Ko Jhukaya Abbas
Tumne Bhai Nahi Aaqa Mujhe Samjha Abbas
Tumko Deta Hoo Mai Baba Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tumne Zainab Ko Bhi Shehzadi Ka Darja Baksha
Tumne Zainab Ki Eta'at Ko Muqaddar Jana
Tumne Zainab Ki Har Ek Baat Ko Tasleem Kiya
Huqm E Zainab Se Hi Khaimo Ka Thikana Badla
Tumko Deta Hoo Mai Zainab Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kya Mera Sath Nhi Aata Hai Ab Raas Tumhe
Kya Nahi Hai Meri Tanhai Ka Ehsaas Tumhe
Maine Bete Ki Tarah Paala Hai Abbas Tumhe
Jao Jana Hi Hai Amma Ke Agar Paas Tumhe
Tumko Deta Hoo Mai Amma Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tum Ho Zakhmi Tumhe Abbas Aziyat Hai Bahot
Mashk Bhi Chid Gayi Ghum Geen Tabiyat Hai Bahot
Janta Hoo Tumhe Apne Se Shikayat Hai Bahot
Tumko Nashaad Sakina Se Nidamat Hai Bahot
Tumko Us Pyaasi Sakina Ki Duhai Bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aye Qamar Sheh Ki Tamanna Ko Jo Ghazi Ne Suna
Roke Kehne Lage Mai Aap Ki Azmaat Pe Fida
Umr Bhar Aapko Jis Muh Se Kaha Hai Aaqa
Kaise Us Muh Se Mai Keh Paunga Bhai Maula
Huqm Ab Aapka Hai Aur Hai Duhai Bhai
Marte Dum Is Liye Kehta Hoo Mai Bhai Bhai..

items.title: Woh hai sakina
items.body:
Wo h sakina wo h sakina
Jispe sitam yu hue bade shahe karbala
Kano se bunde chhine kurte ka daman jala
Shimr ka rukhsar pe jiske tamacha laga
Jisko zamane ne ik qatra na pani diya
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Roti rhi yaad me baba ki jo umr bhar
Puchhti thi maa se ye baba kab aayenge Ghar
Rooth gye mujhse kyu Haye shahe bahro bar
Amma meri jaa'n hi na le le ye yaade pedar
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Jisne jawa'n bhai k sine me dekhi sena
Mar gaya peshe nazar bhai bhi ik be zaba'n
Aur chacha abbas bhi laut k aaye kaha'n
Chhut gaye ik Roz me sare hi peero jawa'n
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Dekha hai jisne dhuan khaimo se uthte hue
Sir se reda maao or phuphiyo ki chinte hue
Bistare beemar ko sholo me jalte hue
Pushte pe her aik ki durre braste hue
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Uspe rahe sham me Haye hui yu jafa
Pusht se naqe ki jab bachi ko bandha gya
Ho gya chhalni badan haye Jo naqa chala
Apne chacha jaan ko deti thi Roker sada
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Jiske watan jane ka pura na arma'n hua
Krti rhi yaad me sheh ki jo aaho buka
Jisko na phirse kbhi baba ka sina mila
Sham k zindan me aagyi jisko qaza
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sitam
Bachi pe Minhal jo toote hain zulmo sitam
Haye suhail e hazee kaise bhala ho raqam
Ab bhi sada aati hai sham se ye du ba dum
Aake khabar lo Zara meri ae shaahe umam
Jispe toote hain Alam jispe yu hue sita

items.title: Boli Maa Aun Aur Muhammad Se
items.body:
Boli ma Aun aur Muhammad se, Jaan Shabbir par Lutana hai
Karna Sharminda na ay shahzado, Amma Zehra ko muh Dikhana hai
Saare Ashaab mere bhai ke, be khata dasht me hain maare gae
Koi bhi abb nahi hai khaimo me, apni jaan bhai per fida karde,
Ayse mushkil ghadi me ay beto, sheh ki tanhai ko mitana hai.
Ummati hoke bhi paraye hain, aale Ahmed se ladne aae hain,
Badr o siffin ka hai gham taaza, badla haider se lene aae hain,
Jao jab unke tum muqabil per, naara-e haidery lagana hai.
Tumse nazre nahi milaugi, shikwe nani ko hai sunaogi,
Zinda wapas joh aae khaimo me, seene tumko nahi lagaugi,
Chahte hoke tumse raazi rahu, sheh ki khatir ghale katana hai.
Barchi seene pe khaega Akbar, hoga tukdo me Qasim dilbar,
Jinko parwaan khud chadaya hai, unke laashe uthaege sarwar,
Bhai maqtal me tumko jab dekhe, apne har zakhm ko chhupana hai.
Jaanti ho ke tum bhi ho pyase, ladlo ha magar yeh yaad rahe,
Pyase bache hai abb bhi khaimo me, boond paani na halq se utray,
Paani ko dekh kar khayal rahe, pehle besheer ko pilana hai.
Lashe baccho ki lae jab sarwar, har koi peetta tha sina o sar,
Inna lilla h padhke boli maa, tumpai hargiz na roegi muztar,
Mujhko apne ghareeb bhai par, khoone dil aanko se bahana hai.
Qaid se chhoot kar joh binte Ali, karbala hoke apne ghar pahochi,
Nanne nanne musalle jab dekhe, karke rukh Karbala ka kehne lagi,
De mujhe izn mere majae, aaj beto ka gham manana hai.
Joh bhi nauha jawad likhta hai, yeh tere ladlo ka sadka hai,
unke taboot jab bhi uthtay hain, ashk behte hain dil tadapta hai,
Joh na roo paayi apne pyaro ko, uske baccho ka gham manana hai.

items.title: Deeva Baleya Na Phul Paaey Eh
items.body:
DEEVA BALEYA NA PHUL PAAEY EH QABAR KEDI EH RAHWAAN VICH
IK MASOOMA SI MAR GAEY EH QAIDI VEERAN DIAAN BAAVAAN VICH
ABID NAL LIPAT KE RONDI SI KEEVAIN VAKHRI QAID NIBHAAVAANGI
CHAD KE KALEYA MENU JAAVEEN NA CHAN VEERAN MEIN MAR JAAVAANGI
SUN KE GALLAAN ZINDAAN ROVAY JO HOYAAN BHEN BHIRAAVAAN VICH
MERE DARDAAN DA EHSAAS KAREEN KEEVAIN BABAY NU MEIN BHUL JAAVAAN
TAKH ZAALIM MOJZA UJRI DA SHABBIR DI DHI MEIN DIKHLAAVAAN
MERA PEU NAIZAY TE RO PAYA EH EH ASSAR HE MERIAAN HAAVAAN VICH
LAKH ZULM KARAY EH SHIMR LAEEN MEIN RONA EH MEIN ROVAANGI
BABAY DI QABAR TE JAAVAANGI JADON VEER AZAAD MEIN HOVAANGI
ABID TON PUCHDI TAKH URDE PANCHI AZAD HAVAAVAAN VICH
SHABBIR DI JAAEE DE GHAM VICH JERA DO ATHROON VI VAHAAEGA
DUKH YAAD KARAY GA UJRI DAY JERA TABOOT UTHAAEY GA
ONU SAIN SAKINA MAHSHAR TAK RAKHAY GI YAAD DUAAVAAN VICH
KEEVAIN HOEE MAUT SAKINA DI ZAINAB NE KEYA SAJJAD DASA
ABID NE KEYA KI HAAL DASAAN JADOON MEIN MASOOMA KOL GAYA
BABAY DA NAA SI US VAYLAY UJRI DAY AKHRI SAAVAAN VICH
SAJJAD OH JHINKAAN JHALDI RAEE BAGHEE DI DHI SAB KENDAY SAN
JADOON YASRAB DE VICH VASDAY SAN SAB HAASHMI NAZ UTHAINDAY SAN
IK SHAHZADI SI PAR RUL GAEY OH KARBAL DE SEHRAAVAAN VICH

items.title: Ali Ali haye Ali
items.body:
Haye Ali Haye Ali Ya Ali Haye Ali
Gul dasta e azan say mua'zzin ne di sada
Qayam hui namaz uthey shahe lafata
Baad e ruku sajda e khalik Mai sir rakha
Sajde say sir uthate he haye Ghazab hua
Aayi nida e ghaib ke Haider hue shaheed
Gharme khuda ke saqiy e Kausar hue shaheed
Ali Ali Haye Ali Aye Mere Moula
Sajde Mai Sir Zakhmi Hua Shere khuda ka
1)
Teghe bine muljim say hai zakhmi sar e Anwar
Or khoN say namaz e ke musalla bhi hua tar
Aate hai nazar khoon mai dubey hue Haider
Masjid Mai lahu behta raha shere khuda ka
2...Teghe bine muljim jo chali farq e Ali par
Is zulm say aalam mai bapa hogaya Mehshar
Marqad Mai larazne lagi khud ruhey payambar
Jibril ne bhi noha padha shere khuda ka
3...Kufey Mai khabar phaili ke Haider hui zakhmi
Mehrab Mai damad e payamber hue zakhmi
Guriya hai falak saqiye Kausar hue zakhmi
Matam hai zamane Mai bapa shere khuda ka
4...Ab aal e Mohammad ko nahi zabt ka yara
Bikhara hua masjid Mai hai quran ka para
Quraan ke maathe say rawaN khuN ka hai dhara
Shamshir say sir zakhmi hua shere khuda ka
5...Aalam Mai Numaya hai jo aasar e Qayamat
Sadat Mai kohram hai maar e gaye Hazrat
Mabud ke ghar Mai hui Bande ki shahadat
Sir sajda e khalik Mai kata shere khuda ka
6...Kufey ke yateemo ke Labo par hai ye fariyad
Ab kon ghareebo ki karega bhala imdad
Koi bhi sahara nhi hum hogaye barbad
Ghar sog mai duba hua shere khuda ka
7...Hai zainabo kulsum ke chehro pa udasi
Abbas ke Rukhsar pa hai gard e yateemi
Hasnain ki aakhon say na kyon ashk hojari
Aalam mai hai taboot utha shere khuda ka
8...Moula ka mere kya ho bayaN haal e shahadat
Is haal Mai bhi karte hai qatil ki ziyafat
Allah re ye jazba e isaaro murawwat
Hamsar koi kya hoga bhala shere khuda ka
9....Sir pit ke jo rotey hai Zehra ke dulharey
Aakash pa larza hai chamak te hue taare
Yun Haider e karra suye khuld sidhare
Mooh takti rahi aale eba shere khuda ka
10....Mazhar ye raqam noha e gham karta rahega
Akbar bhi usey shamo sahar padhta rahega
Her dour Mai apna ye Alam ucha rahega
Saya hai saro par jo sada shere khuda ka

items.title: Dastane Shujaath Ka Darain Me
items.body:
Dastane Shujaath ka darain me ek bemisl kirdar abbas hai
Hai Ali ke Athara Hi bete Ali x2 Par sabhi me Alamdar Abbas Hai
Inke lehje me hashim ki hashmat bhi hai
Inke tewar me hamza ki haibat bhi
Har ada inki imran ka aqs hai
Inki baho me jaffar ki quwwat bhi hai
Pyar hai mustufa ka hussain o hasan
Aur hassnain ka pyar abbas hai
Qabr kya hai andhera sa ghar hai jahan
Marefat ke siva koi sapna nahi
Vo bohat hi andheri jagah hai waha
Koi yawar nahi koi apna nahi
Tumse milne lahad me ali aayenge
Bolo tanhai me aur kya chahiye
Naqle azmat ka shireen samar hai yehi
Ismato ke sadaf ke gohar hai yehi
Noor ki sidratulmuntaha hai yehi
Hashmi aasman ke qamar hai yehi
Jinke saaye me akber bhi palte rahe
Husn ka aisa minaar abbas hai
Hal ata innama ki jo misdaaq hai
Vo bhi ghazi ke aane ki mushtaq hai
Arsh se farsh tak inki jageer hai
Sari maqloq inki gadageer hai
Jo ali ki shujath ka waria bhi hai
Aisa aala zameendar abbas hai
Sahebe taqt akhline gairat hai ye
Aur charaghe hareebe sharafat hai
Zore shehwar Behre saqawat hai ye
Haq to ye hai ke haq ki haqeeqat hai
Vo duwwayen jo bibi ne sajdo me ki
Kul duaoo ka meyar abbas hai

items.title: Koi pehchan na le
items.body:
Haye shaam, haye sham..(2)
koi pehchan na le..(2)
haye har gaam pe hai ehle haram nauha gar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
Be rida aale nabi ko kahi'n dauran e safar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
haye har gaam pe hai ehle haram nauha gar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aayi thi kufe mein ban kar jo kabhi shehzadi
kal talak karti thi jis shehr pe zainab shahi
kabhi hukmura'n thi is shehr ki
thi jis ki yaha'n hukumat kabhi
aaj kufe mein wohi aayi hai qaidi bankar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaise batlau bhala jo tha ta'arruf mera
maa hu akbar ki mera naam hai umme laila
sare shaam hai ajab marhala
tu naize pe hai mera sar khula
kar rahi hai ye dua aaj teri maa akbar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Malik e kausar o tasneem hai nana mera
bhai Hasnain hai aur baap Ali maa Zehra
ye qismat kaha'n mujhe laayi hai
musalmaan har tamashayi hai
sar jhuka leti hai ye soch ke binte haider
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aaj hai zainab o kulsoom ke sar bechadar
haath paband e rasan aur hue gird e safar
aseer e sitam hai saydaniya
hai ye nauhagar nabi zadiya'n
nauke naiza pe buka karta hai shabbir ka sar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Nauke naiza pe nazar aate hai jo chand se sar
wo jo bimaar hai ghash aata hai jisko aksar
aseere jafa aseere sitam
sare shaam hai nabi ke haram
haye kis haal mein hai Ahmed e mukhtar ka ghar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Qafila ehle haram, qafila salaar hu mai
mere kunbe pe sitam hote hai ghum khwar hu mai
khule sar haram sare rah guzar
mai kuch is tarha hu mehwe safar
khauf taree yehi rehta hai hamesha dil par
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aaj ye ehle haram pe hai sitam aarayi
tanz karta hai koi kehta hai koi baaghi
bade dil shikan ye haalat hai
ghareebul bewatan ye sadaat hai
maare ghairat ye dua maang rahe hai muztar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jiska parda tha mujhe jaan se badhkar pyara
aaj bazaar e jafa mein hai wohi be parda
sare sham hai behan sar khule
basad ranjo ghum ye kehte hue
gir gaya khaak pe naize se alamdaar ka sar
koi pehchan na le..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ho hamid abidi is ghum ka madawa kaise
bhule wo zulm bhala saniye Zehra kaise
qadam dar qadam musibat mili
jafa kaun si na safdar hui
sham mein zainab e muztar ne dua ki rokar
koi pehchan na le..(2)

items.title: Like You O'Hussain (a.s) There is No Other
items.body:
Son of Allah’s fearless warrior, Oh Hussain (as)
Master of the youth of paradise, Oh Hussain (as)
Oh the Master of Martyrs, Oh Hussain (as)
Whoever takes your name, Allah blesses them with more than they can wish for,
Oh Hussain
Angels are granted with wings in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
People are blessed with sons in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
The world sheds tears in your name, Oh Hussain (as)
Life in your name
Death in your name
Unbearable is the sorrow,
Nerve-racking is the agony you put up with
For humanity and for truth to prevail
Oh Hussain (as) Oh Hussain (as) Oh Hussain (as)
Like You oh Husayn there is no other
Such a brave strong and loyal man
In history you'll never see
The world will never seee
Let us tell you the story of Karbala
Islam is still alive, just because of Karbala ...
and will remain alive, just because of Karbala
You are the grandson of the Prophet and the son of the Imam
You sacrificed all that you had so you could save Islam
Oh Husayn oh Husayn like You there is no other !!
Like you oh Hussain ...
Ur son Ali Akbar, was so dear to you
Bid farewell to your mother you told him to do
You sent him to the battle even though u knew
He would be sacrificed in Allah's name too
A spear was pierced into his wounded chest
He called out oh my master … this death is surely of the best
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You crawled towards the enemy to search for your son
He was the lookalike oof the Prophet, what has been done...
Your nephew Qaasim was adamant to fight
Just like your brother Hassan, was His face's sight
For the truth with all his will and might
He said I have no fear if our path is right
Sweeter than honey to me is death
Oh master by your side, I wish to take my last breath
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You carried the pieces of Qaasims trampled body to the tent
Oh The final sign of my beloved brother was your lamentYour sister Zaynab brought her two young sons to you
What she had come for oh Husayn you knew
My brother please accept my sacrifices too
Aun and Muhammad I have told you what to do
Fight like no other make your Dear Uncle proud
Only then into the tents … will your bodies be allowed
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
Your nephews fought like true warriors but then were killed
On the scorching sand they lay but with happiness ... their eyes were filled
There was Abbas your beloved brother
He was assigned as the army's protector
He made a promise to Husayn's young daughter
That from the river, I'll get you some water
Abbas how can I let you go too
Without you oh my brother, Husayn cried what will I do
Oh Husayn … Oh Husayn
You watched the enemy attack Abbas from all around,
When Abbas fell from his horse You also…., fell to the ground
When there was no one left by your side
Is there anyone to help me you sighed
Then from the tents a holy Lady cried
You ran to see what had happened inside
Out of his cradle fell your 6 month old baby
His mother cried he's thirsty, they'll give him water maybe
Oh Husayn ...
With Asghar towards the enemy you went to check
But the cursed enemyy shot an arrow through, his fragile neck
This is the only wish of MAHUM, SAANIA and ADEEYA
Oh Husayn you must support us to fulfil our endeavour
In the hearts of every person let this feeling be alive
On the lips of every person let this chant always survive
Oh Hussain (as), Oh Hussain (as), Oh Hussain (as), Oh Hussain (as)
MAY MY MOTHER
HUSSAIN (AS) …
BI ABBI ANTA, WA UMMI, YA HUSSAIN (AS)

items.body:

Zindañ mein ek Nannhi si turbat Ko Bana kar -2
1) Durra na koi tumko lagayega aye behna
Hun chhoot ke ab qaid se jayenge Madina
Sajjad yeh kehte rahe ashkoñ ko baha kar
2) Shimr e laeeñ ne khainch ke Jo bunde utare
Kaanoñ se sakina ke bahe khoon ke dhare
Royi tadap ke haaye woh Ammu Ko bula kar
3) Ye dar tha ke phir shimr tamache na lagaye

Giriya woh Kiya Karti thi gardan ko jhuka kar
4) Masoom ke rukh par woh tamacho ke NISHAÑ the
Neele pade rukhsar se bhi khoon rawa'n the
Zindañ me sitam laye haiñ kañtoñ pe chala kar
5) Qasim kabhi akbar kabhi baba ko pukara
Khaye jo tamache toh chacha jaa'n ko bulaya
Hansta tha bahot shimr use durre laga kar
6) Hasrat thi use jayegi ek Roz Madina
Arman watan jane ka pura na ho saka
Ab soyi sada ke liye zinda'n ko basa kar

items.title: Do Shahzaday, Aun o Mohammad Wich Karbal
items.body:
Do Shahzaday, Aun o Mohammad wich Karbal de maray gaye
Zainab day aye dovain bachray, Akbar Asghar toun vare gaye
1- Jadon Aun o Muhammad akhaday sarn, sada akhri waar Salam Amma
Zahra daa ladla roo akhay, may ray Masom saharay gaye
2- Zainab ghurbat day Alam wich, qurbani aap tayar kitti
Pani naye si shahzadayan day, hanjowan nul waal sawarey gaye
3- Aye Aun o Mohammed nay logo, enj samjo Jaffar Haider nay
Sab kainday si jadh larna laye, Zainab day raaj dularay gaye
4- Kadi Akbar Asghar tay Qasim, kadi Aun o Mohammed tay Ghazi
Shabbir da vayra ujar gaya, jadon waro wari saray gaye
5- Shabir day sirr day naal raye, Zainab day putran day vi sirr
Jid jid natiq Quran gaya, uss jaa Quran day parey gaye
6- Izhar o vaila nai bhulna, jadon khaimey saarey zaliman nay
Seerat fer bibiyan day burkhey, haye neyzeyan naal utarey gaye

items.title: Jo Kare Salam
items.body:
Jo Kare Salam
Jo kare salam basad adab Sheh tashnalab ki janab me,
Toh Ba roze hashr ajab nahi ke rawan ho Sheh ki rakaab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo shameem boo-e-Hussain (as) hai, Wo araq me Sheh ki hai boo-e-khush,
Na wo boo hai ambar-o-mishq me, Na wo boo hai itr-o-gulab me.
Jo kare salam..
Shab-e-qatl chaunk ke neend se ye pukari Zainab-e-dil hazeen,
Mujhe haaye Hussain (as) barehna ser nazar aayi Fatima (sa) khwaab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kabhi ser ke baalon se maa meri ye zameen jhaad ke kehti thi,
Na Rahe Khalash khaso khaar ki mere gul ke bistaro khwab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kabhi Paani laake chidakti thi ye sukhan tha lab pe ke soyega,
Gul-e-Bu-Turab ka dil ruba isi ban keg arm turab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo nihal taza ho baagh me usay kaat’te nahi baaghban,
Ye ghazab hai Akbar-e-Naujawan hua qatl ain shabab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo kiya sawal Imam ne ye namaz-e-zohr ka waqt hai,
Mujhe sajda karne do farz hai toh layeen ne bola jawab me.
Jo kare salam..
Na milegi fursate dam zadan na padhen Hussain (as) namaz ko,
Ke nahi qubool ye bandage teri aaj haq ki janab me.
Jo kare salam..
Kaha tab habeeb ne ae layeen ye Hussain (as) sibte Rasool (saw) hai,
Sharaf-o-Kamal Hussain (as) ka hai bayan Hadees-o-kitab me.
Jo kare salam..
Ajab ehle sham the be haya jinhe paas sharm zara na tha,
Sare paake Sibte Rasool (saw) ko gaye le ke bazme sharab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo suno kalam-e-Fasih ko toh durood bhejo Rasool (saw) par,
Ye sila jo do ge salam ka toh shareek hoge sawab me.
Jo kare salam..
Jo kare salam basad adab Sheh tashnalab ki janab me,
Toh Ba roze hashr ajab nahi ke rawan ho Sheh ki rakaab me.
